ENDINLINECODE.title: ENDINLINECODE

ENDREGION.title: ENDREGION

ENDTRY.title: ENDTRY

ERROR.title: ERROR

EXITCASE.title: EXITCASE

EXITWHILE.title: EXITWHILE
EXITWHILE.summary: Terminates the innermost active :WHILE loop and continues with the statement after the matching :ENDWHILE.

FINALLY.title: FINALLY
FINALLY.summary: Starts the cleanup section of a :TRY block and always runs after the protected work completes.

FOR.title: FOR
FOR.summary: Executes a counted loop by assigning a numeric variable, checking it against a numeric limit, and updating it after each iteration.

IF.title: IF
IF.summary: Executes a block of statements only when a condition evaluates to true.

INCLUDE.title: INCLUDE
INCLUDE.summary: Inserts another SSL script's source into the current file so its statements compile as if they were written inline.

INHERIT.title: INHERIT
INHERIT.summary: Specifies the parent class for an SSL class.

LABEL.title: LABEL
LABEL.summary: Marks a named location in a procedure or script for control flow redirection.

LOOP.title: LOOP
LOOP.summary: Skips the rest of the current :WHILE or :FOR iteration and continues with the next iteration of the innermost active loop.

NEXT.title: NEXT
NEXT.summary: Closes a :FOR loop and returns control to the loop's increment-and-test step.

OTHERWISE.title: OTHERWISE
OTHERWISE.summary: Executes the default branch of a :BEGINCASE block when no earlier :CASE branch runs.

PARAMETERS.title: PARAMETERS
PARAMETERS.summary: Declares named input parameters for a script, procedure, method, or constructor.

PROCEDURE.title: PROCEDURE
PROCEDURE.summary: Declares a named routine body that can contain executable SSL statements and end with :ENDPROC ;.

PUBLIC.title: PUBLIC
PUBLIC.summary: Declares public variables shared down the call stack — visible to the declaring scope and every scope it calls.

REGION.title: REGION
REGION.summary: Starts a named region block whose body is stored as text for later retrieval with GetRegion().

RESUME.title: RESUME
RESUME.summary: Continues execution after a legacy :ERROR handler, starting with the statement after the one that failed.

RETURN.title: RETURN
RETURN.summary: Ends the current script, procedure, or method immediately and can optionally return a value.

STEP.title: STEP
STEP.summary: Sets the increment or decrement used by a :FOR loop between iterations.

TO.title: TO

properties.name: UserAgent
properties.description: The User-Agent header value.

properties.name: Timeout
properties.description: Maximum wait, in milliseconds, for the response.

properties.name: ContentType
properties.description: The Content-Type header for the request body (e.g., application/json).

properties.name: ContentLength
properties.description: Byte length of the request body. Set automatically by SetContent; assign explicitly only when streaming bodies you build by hand.

properties.name: Method
properties.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.). Defaults to GET.

properties.name: Accept
properties.description: The Accept header value.

methods.name: AddHeader
methods.description: Adds a custom request header.

methods.name: SetContent
methods.description: Sets the request body. Multiple forms accept text, binary, or multipart content.

methods.name: SetContentFromFile
methods.description: Sets the request body to the contents of a file.

methods.name: CreateHttpForm
methods.description: Returns a multipart form object you can populate and pass to SetContent.

HttpResponse.title: HttpResponse
HttpResponse.summary: An HTTP response — content metadata, headers, and the body as text, XML, or a saved file.

properties.name: ContentLength
properties.description: Length of the response body in bytes, as reported by the server.

properties.name: ContentEncoding
properties.description: The Content-Encoding header value (e.g., gzip).

properties.name: ContentType
properties.description: The Content-Type header value.

properties.name: HeaderNames
properties.description: All response header names, as an array of strings. Use with GetHeader to read individual values.

methods.name: GetHeader
methods.description: Returns the value of a named response header.

methods.name: GetValueAsString
methods.description: Returns the response body as text.

methods.name: GetValueAsXmlDom
methods.description: Returns the response body parsed as an XML DOM object.

methods.name: SaveValueToFile
methods.description: Writes the response body to a file and returns the path.

SSLNameValueContainer.title: SSLNameValueContainer
SSLNameValueContainer.summary: A name/value bag — read or list values from a request's headers, query string, cookies, forms, server variables, or client certificate fields.

properties.name: AllKeys
properties.description: Every key in the collection, as an array of strings. Returns an empty array when the collection has no entries.

SSLRequest.title: SSLRequest
SSLRequest.summary: The incoming HTTP request inside an endpoint script — method, URL, headers, query string, cookies, forms, body, and uploaded files.

methods.name: SaveInputStream
methods.description: Saves the request body to a file and returns the path.

SSLResponse.title: SSLResponse
SSLResponse.summary: The outgoing HTTP response inside an endpoint script — write content, set status, redirect, add headers and cookies.

properties.name: ContentType
properties.description: The response Content-Type header (e.g., application/json, text/html).

properties.name: StatusCode
properties.description: The HTTP status code to send (200, 400, 404, 500, etc.).

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: A free-form tag used to associate the response with a cache invalidation key.

properties.name: CacheRetention
properties.description: How long the response may be cached, in seconds.

properties.name: InvalidateCache
properties.description: When .T., signals that any cached entry for this response should be discarded.

properties.name: InvalidateCacheByTag
properties.description: A tag value; cached entries marked with this tag are discarded.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Appends text to the response body.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Appends the contents of a file to the response body.

methods.name: Redirect
methods.description: Sends a redirect to the given URL.

methods.name: AddHeader
methods.description: Adds a custom response header.

methods.name: AddCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the response.

methods.name: SetCookie
methods.description: Sets (or replaces) a cookie on the response.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Sends any buffered content immediately.

methods.name: End
methods.description: Ends the response — no further content is sent after this call.

methods.name: DisablePageCaching
methods.description: Suppresses caching for this response.

methods.name: Send401
methods.description: Sends a 401 Unauthorized status with the appropriate authentication challenge.

SSLWsRequest.title: SSLWsRequest
SSLWsRequest.summary: The web-service variant of the request object — adds Parameters to everything an SSLRequest exposes.

properties.name: Parameters
properties.description: The positional parameters of the call, in the order the caller supplied them. Empty array when there are no parameters.

SSLWsResponse.title: SSLWsResponse
SSLWsResponse.summary: The web-service variant of the response object — adds Value (the structured return) to everything an SSLResponse exposes.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The script's return value to the web-service caller. The runtime serializes the assigned value into the appropriate response format.

SoapClient.title: SoapClient
SoapClient.summary: Calls SOAP web services — configures the endpoint from a WSDL, supplies credentials, invokes methods.

properties.name: Error
properties.description: The reason the most recent configuration step failed. Empty string when the last step succeeded.

properties.name: TimeOut
properties.description: Maximum wait, in milliseconds, for a CallWebService invocation. Values <= 0 disable the timeout.

properties.name: Parameters
properties.description: The parameter list passed to the next CallWebService invocation. Replace it with another instance, or call its add methods directly.

properties.name: AcceptCookies
properties.description: When .T. (the default), the client retains cookies set by the service across calls.

properties.name: UseDefaultCredentials
properties.description: When .T., calls authenticate with the calling process's default credentials. Falls back to GlobalUseDefaultCredentials when not set explicitly on the client.

properties.name: GlobalUseDefaultCredentials
properties.description: Class-wide default for UseDefaultCredentials. Affects every SoapClient that has not set the property locally.

properties.name: WsAssembly
properties.description: Advanced — a handle to the generated proxy types for the configured WSDL. Used internally by Parameters:CreateCustomType and GetWSType; rarely needed directly.

methods.name: UseWebService
methods.description: Configures the client from a WSDL location, with no credentials.

methods.name: UseWebServiceWithCredentials
methods.description: Configures the client from a WSDL location with explicit user/password.

methods.name: UseProxy
methods.description: Advanced — configures the client from a pre-built proxy file.

methods.name: CallWebService
methods.description: Invokes a SOAP method on the configured service.

methods.name: GetWSType
methods.description: Advanced — returns a handle to a named proxy type.

SoapParameters.title: SoapParameters
SoapParameters.summary: The parameter list passed to the next SOAP method invocation — add scalar, XML-typed, binary, or by-reference parameters.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds one parameter from an XML representation.

methods.name: AddAll
methods.description: Adds several parameters from an XML array.

methods.name: AddByRef
methods.description: Like Add, and flags the parameter as by-reference.

methods.name: AddBinary
methods.description: Adds a binary parameter sourced from a file.

methods.name: AddBinaryByRef
methods.description: Like AddBinary, and flags the parameter as by-reference.

methods.name: AddParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter from an SSL value directly.

methods.name: AddParameterByRef
methods.description: Like AddParameter, and flags the parameter as by-reference.

methods.name: AddParameter2
methods.description: Adds a parameter from an SSL value with an explicit type name.

methods.name: AddParameters
methods.description: Appends every parameter from another SoapParameters (preserving by-reference flags).

methods.name: CreateCustomType
methods.description: Returns a new instance of a custom DTO defined in the WSDL.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all parameters and by-reference flags.

SoapResponse.title: SoapResponse
SoapResponse.summary: The result of a SOAP call — read scalar values, navigate object fields and arrays, save binary results, or get the result as XML.

properties.name: ValueAsStringDate
properties.description: The wrapped value formatted as YYYY-M-D when the value is a date. Empty string otherwise.

properties.name: ValueAsStringTime
properties.description: The wrapped value formatted as HH:MM:SS (zero-padded) when the value is a date/time. Empty string otherwise.

properties.name: Xml
properties.description: The wrapped value serialized to XML. Empty string when serialization fails; in that case, the parent SoapClient's Error property is set.

properties.name: XmlByRef
properties.description: The by-reference parameter values from the call serialized to XML. Empty string when there are none or serialization fails.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the wrapped value as-is.

methods.name: UnWrap
methods.description: Returns the wrapped value, expanding arrays of complex types into arrays of SoapResponse.

methods.name: GetObjectField
methods.description: Returns a named field of a complex result.

methods.name: GetArrayItem
methods.description: Returns an element of an array result.

methods.name: GetArrayLength
methods.description: Returns the length of an array result, or -1 when the result is not an array.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Writes a binary result to a file.

methods.name: GetTypeInfo
methods.description: Returns a name for the wrapped value's type.

methods.name: GetObjectFieldList
methods.description: Returns the names and types of all fields on a complex result, as XML.

AAdd.title: AAdd
AAdd.summary: Appends an element to the end of an array and returns the appended element.

returns.description: The appended value.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Existing array to modify.

parameters.name: vElement
parameters.description: Value to append as the new last element.

AEval.title: AEval
AEval.summary: Evaluate a code block for each array element and return the same array.

returns.description: The same array passed in as `aTarget`.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Array to iterate.

parameters.name: fnBlock
parameters.description: Code block evaluated for each selected element. It receives the current element as its argument.

parameters.name: nStart
parameters.description: 1-based index of the first element to process.

parameters.name: nCount
parameters.description: Number of elements to process. 0 performs no iterations. If the requested range extends past the end of the array, AEval stops at the last element.

AEvalA.title: AEvalA
AEvalA.summary: Evaluate a code block for each selected array element and write the result back to the same array.

returns.description: The same array passed in as `aTarget`, after the selected elements have been updated.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Array to process and update.

parameters.name: fnBlock
parameters.description: Code block evaluated for each selected element. Its return value replaces the current element.

parameters.name: nStart
parameters.description: 1-based index of the first element to process.

parameters.name: nCount
parameters.description: Number of elements to process. 0 performs no updates. If the requested range extends past the end of the array, AEvalA stops at the last element.

AFill.title: AFill
AFill.summary: Fill an array element range with the same value and return the same array.

returns.description: The same array passed in as `aTarget`, after the fill operation.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Array to update.

parameters.name: vValue
parameters.description: Value written into each selected element.

parameters.name: nStart
parameters.description: 1-based index of the first element to fill.

parameters.name: nCount
parameters.description: Number of elements to fill. If omitted, AFill uses the current array length and fills from nStart to the end. If the requested range extends past the end of the array, AFill stops at the last element.

ALen.title: ALen
ALen.summary: Return the number of elements in an array.

returns.description: Number of elements currently in `aTarget`. Returns `0` when the array is empty.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Array whose current element count to return.

AScan.title: AScan
AScan.summary: Return the index of the first array element that matches a value or condition.

returns.description: 1-based index of the first match, or `0` if no match is found.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Array to search. If aTarget is NIL, AScan returns 0.

parameters.name: vValueOrBlock
parameters.description: Value to match or code block evaluated for each element.

parameters.name: nStart
parameters.description: 1-based index where the scan begins.

parameters.name: nCount
parameters.description: Number of elements to scan from nStart. If the requested range extends past the end of the array, AScan stops at the last element.

AScanExact.title: AScanExact
AScanExact.summary: Return the index of the first array element that matches a value or condition exactly.

returns.description: 1-based index of the first exact match, or `0` if no match is found.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Array to search. If aTarget is NIL, AScanExact returns 0.

parameters.name: vValueOrBlock
parameters.description: Value to match or code block evaluated for each element.

parameters.name: nStart
parameters.description: 1-based index where the scan begins.

parameters.name: nCount
parameters.description: Number of elements to scan from nStart. If the requested range extends past the end of the array, AScanExact stops at the last element.

Abs.title: Abs
Abs.summary: Calculates the absolute value of a number.

returns.description: The absolute value of `nValue`.

parameters.name: nValue
parameters.description: The numeric value to get the absolute value of.

AddColDelimiters.title: AddColDelimiters
AddColDelimiters.summary: Qualify each column in an array as table.column with database-specific identifier delimiters.

returns.description: No return value. The function updates `aCols` directly.

parameters.name: sDSN
parameters.description: Data source name used to determine delimiter rules.

parameters.name: aCols
parameters.description: Array of column names to update in place. Each element is replaced with a qualified name.

parameters.name: sTable
parameters.description: Table name used to qualify each column. The function trims this value before using it.

AddNameDelimiters.title: AddNameDelimiters
AddNameDelimiters.summary: Wrap a name in database-specific delimiters.

returns.description: Trimmed and delimited version of `sName`.

parameters.name: sDSN
parameters.description: Data source name used to determine delimiter rules. Unsupported or empty values produce no delimiter characters.

parameters.name: sName
parameters.description: Identifier to wrap in database-specific delimiters. The function trims this value before wrapping it.

AddProperty.title: AddProperty
AddProperty.summary: Add one or more properties to an object.

returns.description: Always returns `NIL`.

parameters.name: oTarget
parameters.description: Object that receives the new property or properties.

parameters.name: vPropName
parameters.description: Property name as a string, or an array of property-name strings. Each name must be a valid property identifier.

AddToSession.title: AddToSession
AddToSession.summary: Store a non-object, non-array value in the current session under a string key.

returns.description: Always returns `NIL`, including when the session context is not available.

parameters.name: sKey
parameters.description: Session key used to store the value.

parameters.name: vValue
parameters.description: Value to store. Objects and arrays are rejected.

AllTrim.title: AllTrim
AllTrim.summary: Remove leading and trailing space characters from a string.

returns.description: `sSource` with leading and trailing space characters removed.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: String whose leading and trailing space characters are removed.

ArrayCalc.title: ArrayCalc
ArrayCalc.summary: Perform a selected array operation by passing an operation code.

returns.description: Result depends on `sOperation`. Statistical operations return a numeric result, `DUP` and `COPY` return a new array, and the in-place operations return `aTarget`. ArrayCalc returns `NIL` when `sOperation` is empty or not recognized.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Target array for the selected operation.

parameters.name: sOperation
parameters.description: Exact operation code such as DUP, SUM, COPY, or SORT. The documented codes are uppercase. Unrecognized values return NIL.

parameters.name: vValue
parameters.description: Extra value used by operations such as MERGE, SORT, ADD, FILL, and INS. For SORT, pass a numeric column index, an array of numeric column indexes, or a comparison code block.

parameters.name: nStart
parameters.description: Starting index used by COPY, DEL, FILL, and INS.

parameters.name: nCount
parameters.description: Element count used by COPY, DEL, and FILL. If the requested range extends past the end of aTarget, ArrayCalc shortens the count to the available elements.

ArrayNew.title: ArrayNew
ArrayNew.summary: Create a new array with up to three dimensions.

returns.description: New array with the requested dimensions. For two-dimensional and three-dimensional arrays, each element of the outer dimensions contains a nested array.

parameters.name: nDim1
parameters.description: Size of the first dimension.

parameters.name: nDim2
parameters.description: Size of the second dimension. If supplied, nDim1 must also be supplied and greater than zero.

parameters.name: nDim3
parameters.description: Size of the third dimension. If supplied, nDim2 must also be supplied and greater than zero.

ArrayToTVP.title: ArrayToTVP
ArrayToTVP.summary: Convert a one-dimensional array into a table-valued parameter object.

returns.description: TVP object created for the selected database platform.

parameters.name: aValues
parameters.description: Source array. Must be one-dimensional. Empty arrays are allowed.

parameters.name: sDataType
parameters.description: Optional TVP type hint. "INT" forces integer handling. "DOUBLE" and "DATE" are recognized but fail during TVP construction. Any other string falls back to string handling. Non-string values are treated the same as omission.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Optional database connection name. Non-string values are treated the same as omission.

Asc.title: Asc
Asc.summary: Return the character code of the first character in a string.

returns.description: Numeric code of the first character in `sSource`.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: Source string whose first character is evaluated. Pass a non-empty string.

At.title: At
At.summary: Finds the first occurrence of a substring in a string and returns its one-based position.

returns.description: The one-based position of the first match, or `0` when no match is found.

parameters.name: sSubString
parameters.description: Substring to look for.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: String to search.

BeginLimsTransaction.title: BeginLimsTransaction
BeginLimsTransaction.summary: Starts a LIMS database transaction on the default connection or on a named connection.

returns.description: Returns `.T.` when the transaction scope starts successfully. Raises an error if the transaction cannot be started.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Connection name of the LIMS database connection to use. If omitted or empty, the default connection is used. Passing a non-string value raises an error.

parameters.name: sIsoLevel
parameters.description: Transaction isolation level. Recognized values are Read Uncommitted, Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable, and Snapshot. Matching is case-insensitive. If omitted, empty, or passed as a non-string value, the server default isolation setting is used. Any other non-empty string falls back to Read Uncommitted.

Branch.title: Branch
Branch.summary: Transfers control to a label in the current procedure.

returns.description: Does not return a value for application logic. Redirects control flow when a matching label is found.

parameters.name: vTarget
parameters.description: Target label text. A string literal is used directly as the target text. Any other expression is evaluated and converted to a string before SSL compares it to the labels registered in the current procedure.

BuildArray.title: BuildArray
BuildArray.summary: Splits text into a one-dimensional array using a literal delimiter.

returns.description: A one-dimensional array of strings.

parameters.name: sText
parameters.description: Source text to split. NIL or whitespace-only input returns {}.

parameters.name: bCrlfOk
parameters.description: When .F., removes CR/LF pairs from the source text before splitting.

parameters.name: sDelimiter
parameters.description: Literal delimiter used to split the source text.

parameters.name: bUnique
parameters.description: Accepted for compatibility, but currently has no effect.

parameters.name: bTrimSpaces
parameters.description: When .T., trims leading and trailing spaces from each returned element.

BuildArray2.title: BuildArray2
BuildArray2.summary: Parses text into a two-dimensional array using separate row and column delimiters.

returns.description: A two-dimensional array of strings. Each top-level element is a row array.

parameters.name: sText
parameters.description: Source text to parse. NIL or whitespace-only input returns {{""}}.

parameters.name: sLineDelimiter
parameters.description: Literal delimiter used to split the source text into rows.

parameters.name: sColDelimiter
parameters.description: Literal delimiter used to split each row into columns.

parameters.name: bCrlfOk
parameters.description: When .F., removes CR/LF pairs from each row before splitting it into columns.

parameters.name: bTrimSpaces
parameters.description: When .T., trims leading and trailing spaces from each returned cell.

BuildString.title: BuildString
BuildString.summary: Builds one string from array elements using a delimiter.

returns.description: A delimited string built from the selected array elements after each element is converted to text and trimmed.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Source array to convert into one delimited string.

parameters.name: nStart
parameters.description: 1-based index of the first element to include. Must be an integer-valued number.

parameters.name: nCount
parameters.description: Number of elements to include starting at nStart. When omitted, the function uses ALen(aTarget), which effectively includes elements from nStart through the end of the array. Must be an integer-valued number.

parameters.name: sDelimiter
parameters.description: Delimiter inserted between output elements.

BuildString2.title: BuildString2
BuildString2.summary: Builds one string from a two-dimensional array using separate row and column delimiters.

returns.description: A string built by joining each row with `sLineDelimiter` after each row is joined with `sColDelimiter`.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Two-dimensional source array. Each top-level element must be a row array.

parameters.name: sLineDelimiter
parameters.description: Delimiter inserted between row strings.

parameters.name: sColDelimiter
parameters.description: Delimiter inserted between values inside each row.

BuildStringForIn.title: BuildStringForIn
BuildStringForIn.summary: Builds a quoted string list for a SQL IN clause from an array.

returns.description: A parenthesized list of single-quoted values in the format `('value1','value2',...)`, ready to append to a dynamic SQL `IN` clause. Returns the sentinel `('C7082BA7C83D38CAE98421BE494753931F8B52A8')` when `aTarget` is `NIL` or empty.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Array whose values will be converted into one quoted string list for a SQL IN clause.

CMonth.title: CMonth
CMonth.summary: Returns the full month name for a date value.

returns.description: The full month name for `dDate`. Returns `""` when `dDate` is an empty date.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: Date value to convert to a full month name.

CToD.title: CToD
CToD.summary: Converts a string in the current SSL date format to a date value.

returns.description: The parsed date value, or an empty date when `sDateString` cannot be parsed with the current date format setting.

parameters.name: sDateString
parameters.description: Text to parse using the current configured date format.

CheckOnFtp.title: CheckOnFtp
CheckOnFtp.summary: Checks whether a remote file exists on an FTP server, or on an SFTP server when bIsSFTP is .T..

returns.description: `.T.` when the remote file exists and the check succeeds; `.F.` when the file is not found or the check fails.

parameters.name: sServerNameOrIP
parameters.description: Remote server name or IP address.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectory
parameters.description: Remote directory combined with sRemoteFileName to build the lookup path. On SFTP, an empty directory checks sRemoteFileName directly.

parameters.name: sRemoteFileName
parameters.description: Remote file name to check.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name passed to the FTP or SFTP login operation.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password for password-based login. When sPrivateKeyFilePath is supplied on the SFTP path, this value is used as the private-key passphrase.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: Server port. If omitted or non-positive, the implementation uses 21.

parameters.name: sProxy
parameters.description: Must be left empty. Supplying a non-empty value raises an error.

parameters.name: bIsSFTP
parameters.description: Set to .T. to use the SFTP implementation. Omitted or NIL keeps the FTP implementation.

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: Optional private key file for SFTP authentication. Ignored on the FTP path.

ChkNewPassword.title: ChkNewPassword
ChkNewPassword.summary: Validates that a proposed password is not already present in stored password history.

returns.description: `.T.` when `sPassword` is not found in `vPrevPasswords`; otherwise `.F.`.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Candidate password to validate. Passing NIL raises an exception.

parameters.name: vPrevPasswords
parameters.description: Prior passwords as either a comma-separated string or an array. Pass NIL or "" when no stored history is available.

ChkPassword.title: ChkPassword
ChkPassword.summary: Checks whether a user name and password combination is accepted.

returns.description: `.T.` when the credentials are accepted; otherwise `.F.`.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name to validate. If NIL, the function uses the current session user. If the value contains \, the function first attempts Windows authentication and then falls back to the user name portion for the application password check if needed.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password to validate. If NIL, the function uses an empty string.

Chr.title: Chr
Chr.summary: Converts a numeric character code to a single-character string.

returns.description: The single-character string for the rounded character code.

parameters.name: nAsciiCode
parameters.description: Numeric character code to convert. If omitted or NIL, Chr uses 0. Fractional values are rounded to the nearest whole number using away-from-zero rounding before conversion.

ClearLastSSLError.title: ClearLastSSLError
ClearLastSSLError.summary: Clears the stored SSL error so later error checks start clean.

returns.description: Always returns `.T.`.

ClearSession.title: ClearSession
ClearSession.summary: Clears all values from the current session.

returns.description: Returned after the current session is cleared successfully.

ClientEndOfDay.title: ClientEndOfDay
ClientEndOfDay.summary: Returns the end of the client's calendar day for a date value.

returns.description: A date value set to `23:59:59.997` for the applicable client-local day. If `dDate` is an empty date, the original value is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: The date value to convert to the end of the client-local day.

ClientStartOfDay.title: ClientStartOfDay
ClientStartOfDay.summary: Returns the timestamp for the start of the client's calendar day.

returns.description: A date value representing the start of the applicable client-local day. If `dDate` is an empty date, the original value is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: The date value to convert to the start of the client-local day.

CombineFiles.title: CombineFiles
CombineFiles.summary: Concatenates multiple files into one output file on disk.

returns.description: An empty string on success.

parameters.name: aFileNames
parameters.description: Array of source file paths to copy into the output file in array order

parameters.name: sOutFile
parameters.description: Destination file path for the combined output

CompArray.title: CompArray
CompArray.summary: Determines whether two arrays are exactly equal.

returns.description: `.T.` when both arrays have the same length and each corresponding element has the same type and exact value. `.F.` when the length differs, when matching positions hold different types, or when any value or nested array content differs.

parameters.name: a1
parameters.description: First array to compare

parameters.name: a2
parameters.description: Second array to compare

Compress.title: Compress
Compress.summary: Compresses a non-empty string and returns the compressed result as either a base64 string or a generated file path.

returns.description: A base64-encoded compressed string when `bToFile` is omitted or is not `.T.`; the full path to the generated compressed file when `bToFile` is `.T.`.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: Text to compress. Must be a non-empty string.

parameters.name: bToFile
parameters.description: When .T., writes the compressed bytes to a generated file in the application work Temp folder and returns that file path. Any other value behaves like the default in-memory mode.

ConvertReport.title: ConvertReport
ConvertReport.summary: Converts a report file identified by a file path and returns .T. when the conversion completes.

returns.description: `.T.` when the conversion completes successfully. Failure raises an error instead of returning `.F.`.

parameters.name: sFile
parameters.description: Source file path for the report to convert

CopyToFtp.title: CopyToFtp
CopyToFtp.summary: Appends the same text content to one or more files on an FTP or SFTP server.

returns.description: `.T.` when all requested uploads succeed; `.F.` when any upload fails. An empty `aRemoteFileNames` array returns `.T.`.

parameters.name: sServerNameOrIP
parameters.description: Name or IP address of the FTP server

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectory
parameters.description: Remote folder path. In SFTP mode, an empty value causes each aRemoteFileNames entry to be used as the full remote path.

parameters.name: aRemoteFileNames
parameters.description: Array of remote file names. The function uploads the same content to each entry. NIL is not allowed, but an empty array is accepted and returns success without uploading anything.

parameters.name: sFileContents
parameters.description: Text to append to each remote file. NIL is treated as an empty string.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name passed to the FTP or SFTP login step.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password used for FTP login. In SFTP mode, it is used for password login when sPrivateKeyFilePath is empty, or as the private-key passphrase when sPrivateKeyFilePath is provided.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: Port number. Omitted, NIL, or non-positive values fall back to 21.

parameters.name: sProxy
parameters.description: Must be omitted, NIL, or empty. Any non-empty value raises an argument error.

parameters.name: bIsSFTP
parameters.description: When .T., the call uses the SFTP implementation instead of the FTP implementation.

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: SFTP-only private key path. When provided, the SFTP branch attempts private-key authentication. Ignored in FTP mode.

CreateGUID.title: CreateGUID
CreateGUID.summary: Generates a new GUID string in uppercase.

returns.description: A newly generated GUID string in standard hyphenated uppercase form.

CreateLocal.title: CreateLocal
CreateLocal.summary: Creates or overwrites a local variable in the current scope by name.

returns.description: Returns the supplied `vVarValue`. If `vVarValue` is omitted, the local variable is still created with `""`, and the call returns no value.

parameters.name: sVarName
parameters.description: Name of the local variable to create or overwrite

parameters.name: vVarValue
parameters.description: Value to store in the local variable. If omitted, the local variable is initialized to an empty string

CreateORMSession.title: CreateORMSession
CreateORMSession.summary: Creates the shared ORM session object for the current SSL runtime, or returns the existing one if it has already been created.

returns.description: The shared ORM session object.

CreatePublic.title: CreatePublic
CreatePublic.summary: Creates or overwrites a public variable by name.

returns.description: The supplied `vVarValue`. If `vVarValue` is omitted, the public variable is created with `""`, and the call returns no value.

parameters.name: sVarName
parameters.description: Name of the public variable to create or overwrite

parameters.name: vVarValue
parameters.description: Value to store in the public variable. If omitted, the public variable is initialized to an empty string

CreateUdObject.title: CreateUdObject
CreateUdObject.summary: Creates a dynamic object or instantiates a user-defined class.

returns.description: The returned object depends on the call form:

parameters.name: aPropertyDefs
parameters.description: Property definitions for the dynamic object. Each element must be either a property name string or a two-element array of {propertyName, initialValue}. A bare property name creates the property with an empty-string value.

parameters.name: sClassName
parameters.description: Name of a user-defined :CLASS to instantiate. Not for built-in classes such as Email{} or SSLDataset{}.

parameters.name: aArgs
parameters.description: Constructor arguments for the class-name form. Pass all arguments as one array in call order, even when there is only one argument.

CreateZip.title: CreateZip
CreateZip.summary: Creates a ZIP archive from a source directory.

returns.description: `CreateZip` performs its work by creating the archive and does not return a result value.

parameters.name: sZipFileName
parameters.description: Full path and file name for the ZIP file to create.

parameters.name: sSourceDirectory
parameters.description: Directory whose contents will be added to the archive.

parameters.name: bRecurse
parameters.description: When .T., includes matching files from subdirectories. When .F., scans only the top level of sSourceDirectory.

parameters.name: sFileFilter
parameters.description: Case-insensitive regular-expression filter applied to each file's full path while scanning. You can combine include and exclude expressions with ;. When omitted, all files are eligible.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password applied to the ZIP archive when supplied.

DOW.title: DOW
DOW.summary: Returns the numeric day of week for a date.

returns.description: the weekday number for the supplied date, or `0` when the date is empty

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: The date value to evaluate

DOY.title: DOY
DOY.summary: Calculates the ordinal day number of a date within its year.

returns.description: The day of the year for `dDate`, from `1` to `366`

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: Date value whose ordinal day within the year should be returned

DToC.title: DToC
DToC.summary: Converts a date value to a string using the current SSL date format.

returns.description: Formatted date string using the current date format setting. If `dDate` is empty, returns `" / / "`.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: Date value to convert to a string

DToS.title: DToS
DToS.summary: Converts a date value to an 8-character string in yyyyMMdd format.

returns.description: Fixed-width 8-character result. Returns `yyyyMMdd` for a populated date, or eight spaces when `dDate` is empty.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: Date value to convert to yyyyMMdd

DateAdd.title: DateAdd
DateAdd.summary: Adds a time interval to a date and returns the resulting date.

returns.description: A new date representing `dDate` shifted by `nNumber` units of `sDatepart`.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: The source date value.

parameters.name: nNumber
parameters.description: The numeric offset to add.

parameters.name: sDatepart
parameters.description: The interval to add: year, month, day, hour, minute, second, or millisecond. If omitted, NIL, or not a string, DateAdd uses day.

DateDiff.title: DateDiff
DateDiff.summary: Returns the whole-number difference between two date values in a requested unit.

returns.description: A whole-number difference between `dStartDate` and `dEndDate` in the requested unit:

parameters.name: dStartDate
parameters.description: The starting date value.

parameters.name: dEndDate
parameters.description: The ending date value.

parameters.name: sDatepart
parameters.description: Unit to return: "year", "month", "day", "hour", "minute", "second", or "millisecond". If omitted or not a string, DateDiff uses "day".

DateDiffEx.title: DateDiffEx
DateDiffEx.summary: Returns the elapsed interval between two date values as an object.

returns.description: An interval object representing `dEndDate - dStartDate`. Read the members you need from the returned object rather than expecting a single number.

parameters.name: dStartDate
parameters.description: The starting date value.

parameters.name: dEndDate
parameters.description: The ending date value.

DateFormat.title: DateFormat
DateFormat.summary: Sets the current SSL date format string.

returns.description: Always returns an empty string.

parameters.name: sNewFormat
parameters.description: Date format string to store as the current format. Common token casing is normalized before storage.

DateFromNumbers.title: DateFromNumbers
DateFromNumbers.summary: Creates a date value from individual numeric components.

returns.description: A date built from the supplied components. When all arguments are omitted, returns a local date with year 1, month 1, day 1, and time `00:00:00.000`.

parameters.name: nYear
parameters.description: Year component. When supplied, it must be an integer.

parameters.name: nMonth
parameters.description: Month component. When supplied, it must be an integer.

parameters.name: nDay
parameters.description: Day component. When supplied, it must be an integer.

parameters.name: nHour
parameters.description: Hour component. When supplied, it must be an integer.

parameters.name: nMinute
parameters.description: Minute component. When supplied, it must be an integer.

parameters.name: nSecond
parameters.description: Second component. When supplied, it must be an integer.

parameters.name: nMillisecond
parameters.description: Millisecond component. When supplied, it must be an integer.

parameters.name: bMakeInvariant
parameters.description: Optional flag that controls the returned date kind. Use .T. to return an invariant date. NIL and .F. return a local date.

DateFromString.title: DateFromString
DateFromString.summary: Parses a string into a date value with optional format and culture controls.

returns.description: The parsed date value, marked as local when `bMakeInvariant` is `NIL` or `.F.`, or as an unspecified date when `bMakeInvariant` is `.T.`.

parameters.name: sDateAsString
parameters.description: Source text to parse.

parameters.name: vFormat
parameters.description: Exact format to use, or an array of exact formats to try. When omitted, the function uses standard parsing for the selected culture.

parameters.name: bUseLocalCulture
parameters.description: When .T., parse with the current local culture. When NIL or .F., parse with invariant culture.

parameters.name: bMakeInvariant
parameters.description: When .T., return an unspecified date. When NIL or .F., return a local date.

DateToString.title: DateToString
DateToString.summary: Converts a date value to a string using a specified or default format.

returns.description: The formatted string representation of `dDate`.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: Date value to format.

parameters.name: sFormat
parameters.description: Output format to apply. If omitted, the default pattern is used.

Day.title: Day
Day.summary: Extracts the day-of-month number from a date value.

returns.description: Returns `1` to `31` for a valid date, or `0` when `dDate` is an empty date.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: The date value from which to extract the day-of-month number.

Decompress.title: Decompress
Decompress.summary: Decompresses compressed text and returns the restored string.

returns.description: The decompressed UTF-8 text.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: Base64-encoded GZip-compressed content, or a file path when bFromFile is .T.. Must be a non-empty string.

parameters.name: bFromFile
parameters.description: When .T., reads compressed bytes from the file path in sSource. Any other value behaves like the default in-memory mode.

DecryptData.title: DecryptData
DecryptData.summary: Decrypts an encrypted string with a password and returns the plaintext string.

returns.description: The decrypted plaintext. Returns an empty string when `sInputData` is empty or when the supplied value cannot be decrypted.

parameters.name: sInputData
parameters.description: The encrypted string to decrypt. If this value is NIL or empty, the function returns an empty string.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: The password used for decryption. If this value is NIL or empty and sInputData is not empty, the function raises an error.

DelArray.title: DelArray
DelArray.summary: Removes an element from an array at a specified one-based index and returns the same array.

returns.description: The same target array after removal. When `nIndex` is within bounds, the element is removed and later elements shift left. When `nIndex` exceeds the array length, the array is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: The array to modify.

parameters.name: nIndex
parameters.description: One-based position of the element to remove. Must be an integer-valued number.

DeleteDirOnFtp.title: DeleteDirOnFtp
DeleteDirOnFtp.summary: Deletes a remote directory over FTP or SFTP.

returns.description: `.T.` when the remote directory is deleted successfully; `.F.` when the server rejects the delete request.

parameters.name: sServerNameOrIP
parameters.description: Remote server host name or IP address.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectory
parameters.description: Remote directory path to remove.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name for the remote server login.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: FTP password, or SFTP password or private-key passphrase.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: Port used for the connection. Values less than or equal to 0 are treated as 21.

parameters.name: sProxy
parameters.description: Must be omitted or blank. A non-empty value raises an error.

parameters.name: bIsSFTP
parameters.description: Set to .T. to use SFTP. Omit it or pass .F. to use FTP.

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: In SFTP mode, when provided, the function loads this key file and uses sPassword as the key passphrase.

DeleteFromFtp.title: DeleteFromFtp
DeleteFromFtp.summary: Deletes a remote file through FTP, or through SFTP when bIsSFTP is .T..

returns.description: `.T.` when the target file is deleted successfully; `.F.` when the delete request fails. On the SFTP path, `.F.` is returned only when the delete fails after a successful connect and login — earlier SFTP failures can raise instead.

parameters.name: sServerNameOrIP
parameters.description: Remote server name or IP address.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectory
parameters.description: Remote directory used with sRemoteFileName to build the target path. When omitted on the SFTP path, the function deletes sRemoteFileName as given.

parameters.name: sRemoteFileName
parameters.description: Remote file name to delete.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name passed to the FTP or SFTP login operation.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password for normal login. When sPrivateKeyFilePath is supplied on the SFTP path, this value is used as the private-key passphrase.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: Server port. If omitted, or if a non-positive value is supplied, the function uses 21.

parameters.name: sProxy
parameters.description: Must be left empty. Supplying a non-empty value raises an error.

parameters.name: bIsSFTP
parameters.description: Set to .T. to use the SFTP implementation. Omitted or NIL keeps the FTP implementation.

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: Optional private key file for SFTP authentication. Ignored on the FTP path.

DeleteInlineCode.title: DeleteInlineCode
DeleteInlineCode.summary: Removes a named inline code entry using a case-insensitive name lookup.

returns.description: `.T.` when the call completes without error, whether the named entry was removed or no inline-code collection existed yet.

parameters.name: sName
parameters.description: Name of the inline code entry to delete.

DetectSqlInjections.title: DetectSqlInjections
DetectSqlInjections.summary: Enables or disables SQL injection detection for a database connection and returns the previous setting.

returns.description: The SQL injection detection state that was in effect before this call.

parameters.name: bEnable
parameters.description: The requested detection state. Pass .T. to enable detection or .F. to disable it. If a non-boolean value is supplied, the function behaves as if .T. was passed.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: The database connection to update. If omitted, empty, or not a string, the function uses the default connection.

Directory.title: Directory
Directory.summary: Retrieves filesystem entries that match a path or wildcard pattern, with optional filtering for directories, hidden entries, and system entries.

returns.description: Array of entry rows.

parameters.name: sFilePattern
parameters.description: Path and wildcard pattern to list, such as "C:\\Reports\\*.txt". If it points to an existing directory, Directory lists that directory with the * pattern. If you pass an empty string, the listing logic uses the current working directory after the whitelist check passes.

parameters.name: sAttributes
parameters.description: Attribute filter string. Uppercase D includes directories, uppercase H includes hidden entries, and uppercase S includes system entries. Other characters are ignored for filtering.

DoProc.title: DoProc
DoProc.summary: Calls a local or scripted procedure by name with an optional argument array.

returns.description: Returns the target procedure's return value.

parameters.name: sProcedureName
parameters.description: Procedure name to invoke. Use a one-segment name for a procedure in the current script, or a three-segment name to dispatch through the same runtime path as ExecFunction.

parameters.name: aArguments
parameters.description: Positional argument array for the target procedure. If omitted, the call runs with no supplied arguments.

DocAcquireWorkitem.title: DocAcquireWorkitem
DocAcquireWorkitem.summary: Acquires a Documentum work item and returns whether the acquisition succeeded.

returns.description: `.T.` when the work item is acquired successfully, or `.F.` when the underlying Documentum acquisition call fails or returns no result.

parameters.name: sWorkitemId
parameters.description: Identifier of the work item to acquire. Passing NIL raises an error.

DocAddUsersToGroup.title: DocAddUsersToGroup
DocAddUsersToGroup.summary: Adds one or more users to an existing Documentum group.

returns.description: `.T.` when the users are added successfully; `.F.` when the group update fails

parameters.name: sGroupName
parameters.description: Name of the existing target group

parameters.name: aUsers
parameters.description: One-dimensional array of user names to add

DocCancelCheckout.title: DocCancelCheckout
DocCancelCheckout.summary: Cancels checkout for a Documentum document and returns a boolean result.

returns.description: `.T.` when the document is resolved and the call completes successfully, including when the document is already not checked out. `.F.` when the Documentum operation fails.

parameters.name: sDocumentId
parameters.description: Document identifier or path to cancel checkout for.

DocCheckinDocument.title: DocCheckinDocument
DocCheckinDocument.summary: Checks a local file into an existing Documentum document.

returns.description: The checked-in object's ID. If the underlying check-in command fails, this function returns an empty string.

parameters.name: sFilePath
parameters.description: Path to the local file to check in.

parameters.name: sDocumentId
parameters.description: Documentum identifier of the existing document.

parameters.name: sVersion
parameters.description: Version label to send with the check-in.

parameters.name: bReplaceContent
parameters.description: Replaces the existing document content when true.

parameters.name: bMajorVersion
parameters.description: Marks the check-in as a major version when true.

DocCheckoutDocument.title: DocCheckoutDocument
DocCheckoutDocument.summary: Checks out an existing Documentum document and returns the local checkout file path.

returns.description: The local file path returned by the checkout operation. If the underlying Documentum command fails, this function returns an empty string.

parameters.name: sDocumentId
parameters.description: Document identifier or path to check out.

DocCommandFailed.title: DocCommandFailed
DocCommandFailed.summary: Checks whether the most recent Documentum command in the current session failed.

returns.description: `.T.` when the most recent Documentum command in the current session context recorded an exception. `.F.` when no exception is currently recorded.

DocCompleteWorkitem.title: DocCompleteWorkitem
DocCompleteWorkitem.summary: Completes a Documentum workflow work item and returns whether the operation succeeded.

returns.description: `.T.` when the work item is completed successfully, or `.F.` when the underlying completion attempt fails.

parameters.name: sWorkitemId
parameters.description: Identifier of the work item to complete. Passing NIL raises an exception.

parameters.name: sSignOffUser
parameters.description: User name for the optional sign-off step. A sign-off is attempted only when this value is not NIL and not blank after trimming.

parameters.name: sSignOffPass
parameters.description: Password passed to the sign-off operation when sSignOffUser triggers sign-off.

parameters.name: sSignOffReason
parameters.description: Reason passed to the sign-off operation when sSignOffUser triggers sign-off.

DocCreateACL.title: DocCreateACL
DocCreateACL.summary: Creates a Documentum ACL and returns the backend result string.

returns.description: Result string returned by the ACL creation call, or `""` when the backend call returns no value.

parameters.name: sAclName
parameters.description: ACL name to create.

parameters.name: sDescription
parameters.description: Optional ACL description.

parameters.name: aGroups
parameters.description: Optional array of group names to pass with the create request.

DocCreateCabinet.title: DocCreateCabinet
DocCreateCabinet.summary: Creates a Documentum cabinet and returns the string result from the create operation.

returns.description: The string returned by the Documentum cabinet-create call, or an empty string when that call does not return a value.

parameters.name: sCabinetName
parameters.description: Cabinet name passed to the Documentum create call.

parameters.name: sCabinetType
parameters.description: Optional cabinet type passed when supplied.

parameters.name: sAcl
parameters.description: Optional ACL name passed when supplied.

DocCreateFolder.title: DocCreateFolder
DocCreateFolder.summary: Creates a Documentum folder under a parent path and returns the string result from the create operation.

returns.description: The string returned by the Documentum folder-create call, or an empty string when that call does not return a value.

parameters.name: sParentPath
parameters.description: Parent Documentum path passed to the create call.

parameters.name: sFolderName
parameters.description: Folder name to create under sParentPath.

parameters.name: sAcl
parameters.description: Optional ACL name passed when supplied.

DocCreateGroup.title: DocCreateGroup
DocCreateGroup.summary: Creates a Documentum group and returns its identifier.

returns.description: Group identifier when the create call succeeds, otherwise an empty string.

parameters.name: sGroupName
parameters.description: Group name to create.

parameters.name: sDescription
parameters.description: Optional group description.

DocCreateUser.title: DocCreateUser
DocCreateUser.summary: Creates a new user account and returns its identifier.

returns.description: The created user identifier, or an empty string when the create operation does not return a value.

parameters.name: sLoginName
parameters.description: Login name for the new user account

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password for the new user account

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: Display name for the new user account

parameters.name: sEmail
parameters.description: Email address for the new user account

parameters.name: sDefaultFolder
parameters.description: Default folder for the new user

parameters.name: sGroupName
parameters.description: Group name to assign to the user

parameters.name: sPermissionSet
parameters.description: Permission set to assign to the user

parameters.name: nUserPrivileges
parameters.description: Numeric privilege value for the new user

DocDelegateWorkitem.title: DocDelegateWorkitem
DocDelegateWorkitem.summary: Delegates a Documentum workflow work item to another user and returns whether the delegation succeeded.

returns.description: `.T.` when the work item is delegated successfully; otherwise `.F.`.

parameters.name: sWorkitemId
parameters.description: Identifier of the work item to delegate. Passing NIL raises an error.

parameters.name: sTargetUser
parameters.description: User name that should receive the delegated work item. Passing NIL raises an error.

DocDelete.title: DocDelete
DocDelete.summary: Deletes a Documentum document by object ID.

returns.description: `.T.` when the delete operation succeeds. `.F.` when the backend delete call fails or does not return success.

parameters.name: sObjId
parameters.description: Document object ID to delete.

parameters.name: bAllVersions
parameters.description: When .T., the backend delete request uses the all-versions form. When .F., it uses the single-version form.

DocDeleteCabinet.title: DocDeleteCabinet
DocDeleteCabinet.summary: Deletes a Documentum cabinet by cabinet identifier.

returns.description: `.T.` when the cabinet delete succeeds. `.F.` when the backend delete call fails.

parameters.name: sCabinetId
parameters.description: Cabinet reference to delete.

parameters.name: bDeepDelete
parameters.description: Delete mode flag passed to the Documentum cabinet delete operation. If omitted, the function uses .T..

DocDeleteFolder.title: DocDeleteFolder
DocDeleteFolder.summary: Deletes a Documentum folder and optionally allows the delete only when the folder is empty.

returns.description: `.T.` when the folder delete succeeds. `.F.` when the Documentum delete operation fails.

parameters.name: sFolderId
parameters.description: Folder reference to delete.

parameters.name: bDeepDelete
parameters.description: When .T., the delete call proceeds recursively. When .F., the call fails if the folder has children. If omitted, the function uses .T..

DocDeleteUser.title: DocDeleteUser
DocDeleteUser.summary: Deletes a Documentum user by login name.

returns.description: `.T.` when the delete completes successfully. `.F.` only when the delete path does not return a value.

parameters.name: sLoginName
parameters.description: Login name of the Documentum user to delete

DocEndDocumentumInterface.title: DocEndDocumentumInterface
DocEndDocumentumInterface.summary: Ends the current Documentum interface context.

returns.description: Always returns `NIL`.

DocExists.title: DocExists
DocExists.summary: Checks whether a Documentum document exists for a given object ID.

returns.description: `.T.` when the document exists. `.F.` when the document does not exist or when the Documentum command does not complete successfully.

parameters.name: sObjId
parameters.description: Object ID of the document to check.

DocExistsUser.title: DocExistsUser
DocExistsUser.summary: Determines whether a Documentum user exists for a supplied login context.

returns.description: `.T.` when the requested user exists in the supplied lookup context. `.F.` otherwise.

parameters.name: sLoginName
parameters.description: Login name used for the Documentum lookup context.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name to test for existence.

DocExportDocument.title: DocExportDocument
DocExportDocument.summary: Exports a specified document to a chosen format and returns the result as a string.

returns.description: The exported document content when the Documentum export succeeds. `""` when the underlying Documentum call returns no value.

parameters.name: sDocumentId
parameters.description: Document identifier to export.

parameters.name: sFormat
parameters.description: Export format to request. When omitted, the one-argument overload is used.

DocGetCabinets.title: DocGetCabinets
DocGetCabinets.summary: Returns the cabinet names available from the current Documentum connection.

returns.description: A one-dimensional array of strings. Each element is a cabinet name.

DocGetDocuments.title: DocGetDocuments
DocGetDocuments.summary: Retrieves documents from a Documentum repository folder as a two-dimensional array.

returns.description: A two-dimensional array. Each row is a 5-element array of strings.

parameters.name: sFolderPath
parameters.description: Repository folder path to query. Passing NIL raises an exception.

parameters.name: sDocTypes
parameters.description: Document type filter. When omitted or passed as NIL, the function filters to dm_document.

DocGetErrorMessage.title: DocGetErrorMessage
DocGetErrorMessage.summary: Returns the message text from the current Documentum error state.

returns.description: The current Documentum error message, or `""` when the active Documentum context has no recorded exception.

DocGetFolders.title: DocGetFolders
DocGetFolders.summary: Retrieves the immediate child folders of a Documentum folder as a sorted two-dimensional array.

returns.description: A two-dimensional array. Each row is a 5-element array of strings.

parameters.name: sParentPath
parameters.description: Repository folder path to query for immediate child folders. Passing NIL raises an exception.

DocGetMetadata.title: DocGetMetadata
DocGetMetadata.summary: Retrieves metadata rows for a Documentum object.

returns.description: A two-dimensional array. Each row is a 6-element array.

parameters.name: sObjId
parameters.description: Object ID or object path to query. Passing NIL raises an exception.

parameters.name: sAttributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated attribute list to request. Omit it, or pass NIL, to request all attributes.

DocGetTasks.title: DocGetTasks
DocGetTasks.summary: Retrieves Documentum workflow tasks as a two-dimensional array.

returns.description: A two-dimensional array. Each row is a 12-element array.

parameters.name: sWorkflowId
parameters.description: Workflow ID to filter by. Pass a non-empty string to return only that workflow's tasks. Pass NIL or "" to return all available tasks.

DocGetTasksCount.title: DocGetTasksCount
DocGetTasksCount.summary: Returns the number of workflow tasks in the Documentum inbox for the active session.

returns.description: The number of workflow tasks in the current Documentum inbox.

DocGetTypeAttributes.title: DocGetTypeAttributes
DocGetTypeAttributes.summary: Retrieves the attribute definitions for a Documentum type as a two-dimensional array.

returns.description: A two-dimensional array. Each row is a 6-element array.

parameters.name: sTypeName
parameters.description: Documentum type name to inspect. Passing NIL raises an exception.

DocGetTypeAttributesAsDataset.title: DocGetTypeAttributesAsDataset
DocGetTypeAttributesAsDataset.summary: Returns the attributes for a Documentum type as a dataset-formatted string.

returns.description: A dataset-formatted string containing the type's attributes. Returns `""` when the underlying Documentum call does not return a dataset.

parameters.name: sTypeName
parameters.description: Documentum type name to query.

DocGetWorkflowStatus.title: DocGetWorkflowStatus
DocGetWorkflowStatus.summary: Returns the current runtime status for a Documentum workflow.

returns.description: The workflow status.

parameters.name: sWorkflowId
parameters.description: Documentum workflow identifier

DocGetWorkitemProperties.title: DocGetWorkitemProperties
DocGetWorkitemProperties.summary: Retrieves workflow flags and linked document IDs for a Documentum work item.

returns.description: A positional array with three booleans followed by zero or more document IDs.

parameters.name: sWorkitemId
parameters.description: ID of the Documentum work item to inspect.

DocImportDocument.title: DocImportDocument
DocImportDocument.summary: Imports a document into Documentum and returns the underlying import result as a string.

returns.description: The string returned by the underlying Documentum import call. Returns `""` when the import operation fails and records an exception in the current Documentum context.

parameters.name: sDocFile
parameters.description: Source file path to import

parameters.name: sDestinationPath
parameters.description: Destination path in Documentum

parameters.name: sDocName
parameters.description: Document name passed to the import operation

parameters.name: sDocType
parameters.description: Document type passed to the import operation

parameters.name: sAppCode
parameters.description: Application code passed to the import operation

parameters.name: sAclName
parameters.description: ACL name passed to the import operation

DocInitDocumentumInterface.title: DocInitDocumentumInterface
DocInitDocumentumInterface.summary: Creates a fresh Documentum interface context for the current execution.

returns.description: Always returns `NIL`.

DocLoginToDocumentum.title: DocLoginToDocumentum
DocLoginToDocumentum.summary: Authenticates to a Documentum repository for the current initialized Documentum context.

returns.description: `.T.` when the login succeeds. `.F.` when the login attempt fails.

parameters.name: sDocBase

parameters.name: sUser

parameters.name: sPassword

DocPauseWorkflow.title: DocPauseWorkflow
DocPauseWorkflow.summary: Temporarily halts workflow processing to prevent further steps until manual intervention or review.

returns.description: `.T.` if the workflow was paused successfully; otherwise `.F.`

parameters.name: sWorkflowId
parameters.description: Identifier of the Documentum workflow to pause

DocRemoveAllUsersFromGroup.title: DocRemoveAllUsersFromGroup
DocRemoveAllUsersFromGroup.summary: Removes every user from a Documentum group.

parameters.name: sGroupName
parameters.description: Name of the group to clear

DocRemoveUsersFromGroup.title: DocRemoveUsersFromGroup
DocRemoveUsersFromGroup.summary: Removes one or more users from an existing Documentum group.

DocRepeatWorkitem.title: DocRepeatWorkitem
DocRepeatWorkitem.summary: Repeats a Documentum workitem and can reassign it to a new user list.

DocResumeWorkflow.title: DocResumeWorkflow
DocResumeWorkflow.summary: Resumes a Documentum workflow identified by sWorkflowId.

returns.description: `.T.` when the workflow resume request succeeds; otherwise `.F.`

parameters.name: sWorkflowId
parameters.description: Identifier of the Documentum workflow to resume

DocSearchAsDataset.title: DocSearchAsDataset
DocSearchAsDataset.summary: Searches Documentum and returns the matches as dataset XML.

returns.description: XML for a dataset with schema information.

parameters.name: sContains
parameters.description: Full-text search text. Blank or omitted values skip the SEARCH DOCUMENT CONTAINS clause.

parameters.name: sObjectType

parameters.name: sWhere

parameters.name: bAllVersions

parameters.name: nResultSetSize

DocSearchFullText.title: DocSearchFullText
DocSearchFullText.summary: Performs a Documentum full-text search and returns matching documents as an array.

returns.description: An array of matching documents.

parameters.name: sTextToSearch
parameters.description: Full-text search text for the Documentum document search.

parameters.name: sStartLocation
parameters.description: Folder path used to scope the search with descendants included. Blank or omitted values do not add folder scoping.

parameters.name: nResultSetSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows requested. A value greater than 0 applies a top-N limit.

DocSearchUsingDql.title: DocSearchUsingDql

DocSetMetadata.title: DocSetMetadata
DocSetMetadata.summary: Updates one or more metadata attributes on a Documentum object.

returns.description: `.T.` when the metadata update completes successfully; `.F.` when the underlying Documentum command fails.

parameters.name: sObjId
parameters.description: Documentum object identifier to update. Passing NIL raises an exception.

parameters.name: aAttributes
parameters.description: Array of two-item arrays in the form {{"attribute_name", value}, ...}. Each row supplies the attribute name at position 1 and the value at position 2.

DocStartWorkflow.title: DocStartWorkflow
DocStartWorkflow.summary: Starts a Documentum workflow and returns the created workflow ID together with the start-activity performers.

returns.description: A two-element SSL array.

parameters.name: sWorkflowId
parameters.description: Workflow identifier to start. Passing NIL raises an SSL argument error. Passing "" or whitespace raises a workflow validation error.

parameters.name: aDocumentIds
parameters.description: Document IDs to attach when the workflow start path expects documents.

parameters.name: sPackageName
parameters.default: "Package0" when the document-package path is used and the value is omitted or blank
parameters.description: Package name used when attaching aDocumentIds to the workflow start activity.

DocStopWorkflow.title: DocStopWorkflow
DocStopWorkflow.summary: Stops a Documentum workflow by its workflow ID.

returns.description: `.T.` when the Documentum stop call reports success; otherwise `.F.`

parameters.name: sWorkflowId
parameters.description: Workflow ID to stop

DocUpdateUser.title: DocUpdateUser
DocUpdateUser.summary: Updates a Documentum user and returns the backend result message.

returns.description: The backend result message, or an empty string when the update path does not return a value.

parameters.name: sLoginName
parameters.description: Login name of the Documentum user to update

parameters.name: sPassword

parameters.description: Permission set value to pass to the update call

parameters.description: Numeric privilege value to pass to the update call

DosSupport.title: DosSupport
DosSupport.summary: Executes operating system-level file and directory commands.

returns.description: The return type depends on the command.

parameters.name: sCmd
parameters.description: Command name. Supported values are DIR, MD, CD, RD, ENV, WORK, WORKDIR, CURRENTDRIVE, ISDIR, and "". Matching is case-insensitive after trimming.

parameters.name: sPrm
parameters.description: Path, file pattern, directory name, or environment variable name, depending on sCmd. It may be omitted only for WORK, WORKDIR, and CURRENTDRIVE.

parameters.name: vDbg
parameters.description: Command-specific third argument. For DIR, it is an optional attribute filter. For MD, CD, and RD, a boolean .T. causes failures to be logged with UsrMes. Other commands ignore it.

Empty.title: Empty
Empty.summary: Returns .T. when a value is considered empty by SSL; otherwise returns .F.

returns.description: `.T.` when `vValue` is empty by SSL rules; otherwise `.F.`.

parameters.name: vValue
parameters.description: Value to test with SSL's built-in emptiness rules.

EncryptData.title: EncryptData
EncryptData.summary: Encrypts a string with a password by using the legacy built-in RC2, DES, or 3DES algorithms.

returns.description: The encrypted value. Successful results begin with a STARLIMS encryption header, followed by the encoded encrypted payload. If `sInputData` or `sPassword` is empty, the function returns `""`.

parameters.name: sInputData
parameters.description: Plaintext to encrypt. If empty, the function returns "".

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password used to derive the encryption key. If empty, the function returns "".

parameters.name: sAlgorithm
parameters.description: Encryption algorithm. Supported values are RC2, DES, and 3DES.

parameters.name: sKey
parameters.description: Requested key length in bits as a string, or MAX.

parameters.name: sRetType
parameters.description: Optional return-type argument retained by the public signature.

EndLimsOleConnect.title: EndLimsOleConnect
EndLimsOleConnect.summary: Disposes an object previously created for OLE automation use.

returns.description: Always returns an empty string

parameters.name: oConnection
parameters.description: OLE automation object to release, typically the value returned by LimsOleConnect

EndLimsTransaction.title: EndLimsTransaction
EndLimsTransaction.summary: Ends a LIMS transaction on the default connection or on a named connection.

returns.description: `.T.` when the transaction scope ends successfully. Raises an exception on failure rather than returning `.F.`.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Connection name of the LIMS database connection to close. If omitted or empty, the default connection is used.

parameters.name: bCommit
parameters.description: Whether to commit the transaction scope. Pass .F. to roll it back.

ErrorMes.title: ErrorMes
ErrorMes.summary: Logs an error message and returns the resulting message string.

returns.description: The string returned by the underlying message routine after the error message is processed.

parameters.name: vCaption
parameters.description: Caption or lead text for the error message.

parameters.name: vMessage
parameters.description: Message body or detail text.

Eval.title: Eval
Eval.summary: Invokes a code block with the supplied arguments and returns the block's result.

returns.description: Returns whatever value the code block produces.

parameters.name: fnCode
parameters.description: Code block to invoke.

parameters.name: vArg1
parameters.description: Optional value passed to the code block. Additional arguments are allowed after vArg1.

ExecFunction.title: ExecFunction
ExecFunction.summary: Invokes a function by name at runtime and returns the result.

returns.description: The return value from the executed function or method.

parameters.name: sName
parameters.description: The name of the function or method to execute. May include a namespace path (e.g., "ServerScript.ClassName.MethodName").

parameters.name: aParameters
parameters.description: An array of parameters to pass to the specified function or method when executed.

ExecInternal.title: ExecInternal
ExecInternal.summary: Calls a method on an object by name and returns that method's result.

returns.description: Whatever value the invoked method returns.

parameters.name: o
parameters.description: Target object whose method will be invoked.

parameters.name: sMethodName
