ExecUdf.title: ExecUdf
ExecUdf.summary: Executes SSL source supplied as a string and returns the result.

returns.description: Returns whatever the dynamic code evaluates or returns.

parameters.name: sCode
parameters.description: SSL source to execute. If it is NIL, it is treated as an empty string.

parameters.name: aArgs
parameters.description: Optional argument array for the dynamic call. When supplied, it must be an array.

parameters.name: bCacheCode
parameters.description: Reuses compiled code for repeated execution of the same source text.

ExtractCol.title: ExtractCol
ExtractCol.summary: Extracts one column from a two-dimensional array and returns the extracted values as a new array.

returns.description: A new array containing the value from `nColumn` for each row in `aTarget`, in row order.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Two-dimensional source array. Each top-level element must be a row array.

parameters.name: nColumn
parameters.description: 1-based column index to extract from each row.

ExtractZip.title: ExtractZip
ExtractZip.summary: Extracts a ZIP archive into a target directory.

returns.description: `ExtractZip` performs its work by writing files and directories and does not return a result value.

parameters.name: sZipFileName
parameters.description: Full path to the ZIP archive to extract.

parameters.name: sTargetDirectory
parameters.description: Directory where the archive contents will be written.

parameters.name: sFileFilter
parameters.description: Case-insensitive regular-expression filter applied to each archived file path. When omitted, all archived files are eligible for extraction.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password used when opening an encrypted ZIP archive.

FileSupport.title: FileSupport
FileSupport.summary: Performs multiple file operations through a single request-driven interface.

returns.description: The return type depends on `sRequest`.

parameters.name: vFileIdentifier
parameters.description: Path for path-based requests, or numeric file handle for handle-based requests. CLOSE, READ, READBLK, WRITE, BOF, EOF, TELL, SEEK, and RESIZE expect a handle. Most other requests expect a path.

parameters.name: sRequest
parameters.description: Request name that selects the operation. Use the canonical names shown above.

parameters.name: vArg1
parameters.description: Request-specific argument. Examples: access mode for OPEN, byte count for READ, delimiter for READBLK, text to write for WRITE, offset for SEEK, new size for RESIZE, destination path for COPY / MOVE / RENAME, and attribute letter for SETATTR.

parameters.name: sArg2
parameters.description: Secondary request-specific string. Used as the share mode for OPEN and the origin for SEEK. Other requests generally ignore it.

parameters.name: sEncoding
parameters.description: Text encoding used when CREATE or OPEN registers a file handle.

FormatErrorMessage.title: FormatErrorMessage
FormatErrorMessage.summary: Returns a formatted string description for an error value.

returns.description: The `SSLError`'s full description (`FullDescription`) when `vError` is an `SSLError` object, or `"Unknown error."` for any other input.

parameters.name: vError
parameters.description: The error value to format. Pass an SSLError object to extract its full description, or any other value to receive "Unknown error.".

FormatSqlErrorMessage.title: FormatSqlErrorMessage
FormatSqlErrorMessage.summary: Returns a human-readable error message from a SQL error value.

returns.description: The `SSLError`'s full description (`FullDescription`) when `vError` is an `SSLError` object, or `"Unknown error."` for any other input.

parameters.name: vError
parameters.description: The error value to format. Pass an SSLError object to extract its full description, or any other value to receive "Unknown error.".

FromJson.title: FromJson
FromJson.summary: Parses a JSON string into the closest SSL-native value or returns the input unchanged if it is not a string. JSON arrays become arrays, objects become SSLExpando instances, numbers become numbers, booleans become booleans, and strings become strings or dates when the value starts with SSLDate|. Null input, empty strings, and JSON null values return NIL. Invalid JSON tokens raise an error.

returns.description: The return type depends on the content of `vValue`:

parameters.name: vValue
parameters.description: A JSON string to parse into native SSL values, or a non-string value returned as-is.

FromXml.title: FromXml
FromXml.summary: Parses a type-tagged XML string and converts it to the corresponding SSL value.

returns.description: The return type depends on the root element tag in `sXml`:

parameters.name: sXml
parameters.description: A type-tagged XML string, typically produced by ToXml.

GetAppBaseFolder.title: GetAppBaseFolder
GetAppBaseFolder.summary: Returns the application's base folder path as a string for use in file and configuration operations.

returns.description: The base folder path configured for the application context.

GetAppWorkPathFolder.title: GetAppWorkPathFolder
GetAppWorkPathFolder.summary: Returns the path to the application's working directory as a string.

returns.description: The application work path folder configured in the system.

GetByName.title: GetByName
GetByName.summary: Retrieves the value of a variable by name from local or public storage.

returns.description: The value of the variable with the specified name

parameters.name: sName
parameters.description: The name of the variable to retrieve. Case-sensitive.

GetConnectionByName.title: GetConnectionByName
GetConnectionByName.summary: Retrieves a database connection object using a specified connection name.

returns.description: The SQL connection object for the specified connection name.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Connection name of the SQL connection to retrieve. If NIL, the default connection name is used. An empty string is not treated as NIL and will fail the lookup.

GetConnectionStrings.title: GetConnectionStrings
GetConnectionStrings.summary: Retrieves all configured database connections as a two-dimensional array.

returns.description: Two-dimensional array of connections. Each row contains three strings: the connection name, the provider name, and the full connection string.

GetDBMSName.title: GetDBMSName
GetDBMSName.summary: Returns the DBMS platform name for a configured database connection.

returns.description: The DBMS platform identifier for the specified connection: `"SQL"` for SQL Server connections and `"ORACLE"` for Oracle connections.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Connection name to look up. If omitted or NIL, the default connection is used.

GetDBMSProviderName.title: GetDBMSProviderName
GetDBMSProviderName.summary: Returns the uppercase DBMS provider identifier for a named database connection.

returns.description: The DBMS provider identifier in uppercase.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Connection name to look up. If omitted, empty, or NIL, the default connection is used.

GetDSParameters.title: GetDSParameters
GetDSParameters.summary: Returns an array of parameter key strings for the named data source.

returns.description: An array of parameter key strings for the specified data source.

parameters.name: sDsName
parameters.description: The name or GUID identifier of the data source whose parameters are to be retrieved.

GetDataSet.title: GetDataSet
GetDataSet.summary: Executes a SQL query on the default database connection and returns the result as an XML dataset string.

returns.description: XML dataset output for the query result.

parameters.name: sCommandString
parameters.description: SQL command text to execute on the default connection.

parameters.name: aValues
parameters.description: Positional values for ? placeholders in sCommandString. Omit when the query has no parameters.

parameters.name: bIncludeSchema
parameters.description: Whether to include XML schema information in the returned string.

parameters.name: sTableName
parameters.description: Table name to assign in the returned dataset XML.

parameters.name: bNullAsBlank
parameters.description: Whether database nulls should be emitted as blank values in the dataset output.

parameters.name: aInvariantDateCols
parameters.description: Array of 1-based column indexes to treat as invariant-date columns.

GetDataSetEx.title: GetDataSetEx
GetDataSetEx.summary: Executes a SQL command on a specified connection and returns the result as XML dataset text.

returns.description: XML dataset output for the command result.

parameters.name: sCommandString
parameters.description: SQL command text to execute.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Database connection name to run the command against. When NIL, the current default connection is used.

parameters.name: aValues
parameters.description: Positional values for ? placeholders in sCommandString. Omit when the query has no parameters.

parameters.name: bIncludeSchema
parameters.description: Whether to include XML schema information in the returned string.

parameters.name: bIncludeHeader
parameters.description: Whether to include the XML declaration/header in the returned string.

parameters.name: sTableName
parameters.description: Table name to assign to the first dataset table in the XML.

parameters.name: bNullAsBlank
parameters.description: Whether database nulls should be emitted as blank values in the XML output.

parameters.name: aInvariantDateCols
parameters.description: Array of 1-based numeric column indexes to treat as invariant-date columns.

GetDataSetFromArray.title: GetDataSetFromArray
GetDataSetFromArray.summary: Builds a dataset XML string from an array of values and an optional array of field names.

returns.description: An XML dataset string generated with header output enabled and schema output disabled.

parameters.name: aArrayOfValues
parameters.description: Values to convert into dataset rows. In the common case, each element is a row array.

parameters.name: aArrayFields
parameters.description: Optional field names. When omitted, NIL, or empty, the function generates Field1, Field2, and so on.

GetDataSetFromArrayEx.title: GetDataSetFromArrayEx
GetDataSetFromArrayEx.summary: Generates a dataset XML string from array values, with control over field definitions, table name, header output, and schema output.

returns.description: An XML dataset string built from the supplied values and output options.

parameters.description: Values to convert into dataset rows. In the common case, each element is a row array. Scalar elements are treated as single-column rows.

parameters.name: aArrayFields
parameters.description: Optional field definitions. Each element may be a field name string or an array definition such as {"field_name", "S", 50}. When omitted, NIL, or empty, the function generates Field1, Field2, and so on.

parameters.name: sTableName
parameters.description: Table name used in the generated dataset when the argument is omitted or NIL. If an empty string is passed, the runtime normalizes it to TABLE.

parameters.name: bIncludeHeader
parameters.description: Whether to include the XML header/declaration in the output.

parameters.name: bIncludeSchema
parameters.description: Whether to include schema metadata in the output. Field type metadata only matters when schema output is enabled.

GetDataSetWithSchemaFromSelect.title: GetDataSetWithSchemaFromSelect
GetDataSetWithSchemaFromSelect.summary: Executes a SQL query and returns the result as XML dataset text with schema always included.

returns.description: XML dataset output for the query result, with the XML header and schema both included.

parameters.name: sCommandString
parameters.description: SQL command text to execute.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Database connection name to run the command against. When NIL, the current default connection is used.

parameters.name: aValues
parameters.description: Positional values for ? placeholders in sCommandString. Omit when the query has no parameters.

parameters.name: aPrimaryKeys
parameters.description: Accepted by the function signature, but currently ignored by the implementation.

parameters.name: aUniqueConstraints
parameters.description: Accepted by the function signature, but currently ignored by the implementation.

GetDataSetXMLFromArray.title: GetDataSetXMLFromArray
GetDataSetXMLFromArray.summary: Generates dataset XML from in-memory values, field definitions, and output flags.

returns.description: XML produced from the supplied rows, fields, and output options.

parameters.description: Values to serialize. In the common case, each element is a row array. If an element is a scalar value, the runtime wraps it as a single-column row.

parameters.name: aArrayFields
parameters.description: Field definitions for the output columns. Each element may be a field name string or a definition array such as {"sample_id", "S", 20} or {"result_value", "N", 10, 2}.

parameters.name: sTableName
parameters.description: Table name used when the argument is omitted or NIL. If you pass an empty string, the generated table name is normalized to TABLE.

parameters.name: bIncludeHeader
parameters.description: Whether to include header information in the generated XML.

parameters.name: bIncludeSchema
parameters.description: Whether to include schema metadata in the generated XML.

GetDataSetXMLFromSelect.title: GetDataSetXMLFromSelect
GetDataSetXMLFromSelect.summary: Executes a SQL query and returns the result as XML dataset text.

returns.description: XML dataset output for the query result.

parameters.name: sCommandString
parameters.description: SQL command text to execute.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Database connection name to run the command against. When NIL, the current default connection is used.

parameters.name: bIncludeHeader
parameters.description: Whether to include the XML declaration/header in the returned string.

parameters.name: aValues
parameters.description: Positional values for ? placeholders in sCommandString. Omit when the query has no parameters.

parameters.name: bIncludeSchema
parameters.description: Whether to include XML schema information in the returned string.

parameters.name: sTableName
parameters.description: Table name to assign to the first dataset table in the XML.

parameters.name: bNullAsBlank
parameters.description: Whether database nulls should be emitted as blank values in the XML output.

parameters.name: aInvariantDateCols
parameters.description: Array of 1-based numeric column indexes to treat as invariant-date columns.

GetDecimalSep.summary: Returns the current decimal separator as a numeric character code.

GetDecimalSeparator.title: GetDecimalSeparator
GetDecimalSeparator.summary: Returns the current decimal separator as a string.

GetDefaultConnection.title: GetDefaultConnection

GetDirFromFtp.title: GetDirFromFtp
GetDirFromFtp.summary: Lists directory entries from an FTP server, or from an SFTP server when bIsSFTP is .T..

returns.description: Array of directory-entry rows on success; `NIL` when the listing request fails.

parameters.description: Remote server name or IP address.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectory
parameters.description: Remote directory to list. The value is passed directly to the FTP or SFTP implementation.

parameters.name: sFilePattern
parameters.description: Wildcard pattern appended to the FTP request path. On the SFTP path, this must be omitted, NIL, or an empty string.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name used for login.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password for FTP login. On the SFTP path, this is also used as the private-key passphrase when sPrivateKeyFilePath is supplied.

parameters.name: bIsSFTP

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: Optional private key file for SFTP authentication. Ignored on the FTP path.

GetFileVersion.title: GetFileVersion
GetFileVersion.summary: Retrieves the file version string for a specified file path.

parameters.description: Path to the file whose version information should be retrieved.

GetFromApplication.title: GetFromApplication
GetFromApplication.summary: Returns a comma-separated string of connected usernames when called with the special key \"STARLIMSUSERS\" in a CUSTOM session context.

parameters.name: sKey
parameters.description: Lookup key. "STARLIMSUSERS" is the only documented key that returns a value.

GetFromFtp.summary: Downloads a file from an FTP or SFTP server to a local file.

parameters.description: FTP or SFTP server host name or IP address.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectory
parameters.description: Remote folder that contains the file. Pass an empty string when the file is in the server's default or root location.

parameters.name: sRemoteFileName
parameters.description: Remote file name to download.

parameters.description: Local path and file name to create. If empty, the function uses sRemoteFileName.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name for FTP or SFTP login.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password for FTP login or password-based SFTP login. When sPrivateKeyFilePath is supplied for SFTP, this value is used as the private-key passphrase.

parameters.name: bIsSFTP

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: SFTP private key file path. Used only when bIsSFTP is .T..

GetFromSession.title: GetFromSession
GetFromSession.summary: Retrieves the value associated with a specified key from the current user session.

returns.description: The value stored for `sKey`. Returns an empty string when the key is not present or when session access is unavailable in the current context.

parameters.name: sKey
parameters.description: Session key to retrieve the associated value.

GetGroupSeparator.title: GetGroupSeparator
GetGroupSeparator.summary: Returns the current group separator as a string.

returns.description: The current group separator.

GetInlineCode.title: GetInlineCode
GetInlineCode.summary: Retrieves a named inline code block as a string.

returns.description: The inline code text for the named block. Returns an empty string when no inline code blocks are defined in the current execution context. Returns the code unchanged when `aVariables` is omitted or `NIL`.

parameters.name: sValue
parameters.description: Name of the inline code block to retrieve.

parameters.name: aVariables
parameters.description: Array of variable names to substitute with their current values in the returned code.

GetInternal.title: GetInternal
GetInternal.summary: Retrieves the current value of a named property from a value that supports property access.

returns.description: Current value returned for the named property.

parameters.name: oTarget
parameters.description: Value whose property will be read

parameters.name: sPropName
parameters.description: Name of the property to retrieve

GetInternalC.title: GetInternalC
GetInternalC.summary: Retrieves a value by applying a chained series of index operations to a root value.

returns.description: The value reached after applying the supplied index chain.

parameters.name: oTarget
parameters.description: Root value to read from

parameters.name: vArg5

parameters.name: vArg6

GetLastSQLError.title: GetLastSQLError
GetLastSQLError.summary: Returns the most recently stored SQL error as an SSLSQLError object, or NIL when no SQL error is currently recorded.

returns.description: The current SQL error object when a database operation has stored an error. Returns `NIL` when no SQL error is currently recorded.

GetLastSSLError.title: GetLastSSLError
GetLastSSLError.summary: Retrieves the most recent SSL error encountered during the current process.

returns.description: The current stored error object. Returns `NIL` when no error has been recorded.

GetLogsFolder.title: GetLogsFolder
GetLogsFolder.summary: Returns the configured user log folder path with a trailing backslash.

returns.description: The configured user log folder path, always with a trailing backslash.

GetNETDataSet.title: GetNETDataSet
GetNETDataSet.summary: Executes a SQL command and returns the result either as dataset XML or as a netobject wrapping a dataset.

returns.description: Dataset XML with schema when `bReturnXml` is omitted or `.T.`; the dataset wrapped for .NET interop when `bReturnXml` is `.F.`.

parameters.name: sCommandString
parameters.description: SQL command text to execute.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Connection name to use.

parameters.name: aValues
parameters.description: Positional values for ? placeholders in sCommandString. Non-array values are replaced with an empty array.

parameters.name: sTableName
parameters.description: Table name to assign to the returned dataset table.

parameters.name: bReturnXml
parameters.description: When .T., returns dataset XML. When .F., returns a netobject wrapping the dataset.

parameters.name: bR1Compatible
parameters.description: When .T., adjusts returned dataset column settings for legacy R1-compatible behavior.

GetNoLock.title: GetNoLock
GetNoLock.summary: Returns the database-specific no-lock clause for a connection.

returns.description: ` WITH (NOLOCK) ` for non-Oracle connections; a single space (` `) for Oracle connections.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Connection name used to resolve the target database. When omitted or empty, the function uses the default connection.

GetPrinters.title: GetPrinters
GetPrinters.summary: Returns a list of printer names currently installed on the system.

returns.description: An array of printer name strings. Returns an empty array when no printers are installed.

GetRdbmsDelimiter.title: GetRdbmsDelimiter
GetRdbmsDelimiter.summary: Returns the identifier delimiter character for the database behind a DSN.

returns.description: One delimiter character, or an empty string when no supported mapping is found.

parameters.name: sDSN
parameters.description: Data source name used to determine the database platform.

parameters.name: bOpen
parameters.description: When .T., returns the opening delimiter. When .F., returns the closing delimiter.

GetRegion.title: GetRegion
GetRegion.summary: Retrieves a named region string from the current region scope and can optionally apply sequential text replacements.

returns.description: The region text. When both `aSourceValues` and `aDestinationValues` are supplied, token replacements are applied in order before returning. Returns an empty string when region storage has not been initialized.

parameters.name: sRegionName
parameters.description: Region name to look up. Matching is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: aSourceValues
parameters.description: Source strings to replace in the retrieved region text. Replacement is only attempted when both aSourceValues and aDestinationValues are supplied.

parameters.name: aDestinationValues
parameters.description: Replacement strings corresponding to aSourceValues. Must have the same number of elements as aSourceValues.

GetRegionEx.title: GetRegionEx
GetRegionEx.summary: Retrieves a named region string, optionally using a caller-supplied local region map before falling back to the current region scope.

returns.description: The matched region text. When both `aSourceValues` and `aDestinationValues` are supplied, token replacements are applied in order before returning. Returns an empty string when no global region storage has been initialized and no local override supplies the requested name.

parameters.name: sRegionName
parameters.description: Region name to look up. Matching is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: aSourceValues
parameters.description: Source strings to replace in the retrieved region text. Replacements are only attempted when both aSourceValues and aDestinationValues are supplied.

parameters.name: aDestinationValues
parameters.description: Replacement strings corresponding to aSourceValues. Must contain the same number of elements as aSourceValues.

parameters.name: oLocalRegions
parameters.description: Compatible local region map to check before the current region scope. If this argument is omitted or not compatible, normal scope lookup is used.

GetSSLDataset.title: GetSSLDataset
GetSSLDataset.summary: Executes a SQL statement and returns the result as an SSLDataset.

returns.description: Dataset wrapper for the command result.

parameters.name: sSql
parameters.description: SQL command text to execute.

parameters.name: sDsn
parameters.description: Database connection name.

parameters.name: aParamNames
parameters.description: Array of parameter names to bind. Parameter binding only happens when both aParamNames and aParamValues are supplied.

parameters.name: aParamValues
parameters.description: Array of values corresponding to aParamNames.

parameters.name: sTableName
parameters.description: Table name assigned to the first table in the returned dataset.

parameters.name: bNullAsBlank
parameters.description: Whether database nulls should be converted to blank values in the returned SSLDataset view.

parameters.name: aInvariantDateCols
parameters.description: Array of invariant date columns. Pass either column names or zero-based column ordinals, and keep the whole array in one form.

GetSetting.title: GetSetting
GetSetting.summary: Retrieves the stored value of a named configuration setting.

returns.description: The stored value for `sName`, returned as the native SSL type (string, number, date, or boolean). Returns `""` when the name is not found.

parameters.name: sName
parameters.description: Name of the setting to retrieve.

GetSettings.title: GetSettings
GetSettings.summary: Retrieves multiple named settings in one call.

returns.description: One entry per requested setting name, in the same order as `aNames`. Each entry is the stored SSL type for that setting (string, number, date, or boolean), or `""` when the name is not found.

parameters.name: aNames
parameters.description: Array of setting names to retrieve.

GetTables.title: GetTables
GetTables.summary: Extracts table names from the FROM portion of a SQL SELECT string.

returns.description: Table names found in the `FROM` portion of the SQL text, one per element. Returns an empty array when the input is `NIL`, empty, or does not match the `SELECT ... FROM` pattern. Names with a leading `#` are returned without the `#`.

parameters.name: sSql
parameters.description: SQL text to inspect for table names.

GetTransactionsCount.title: GetTransactionsCount
GetTransactionsCount.summary: Returns the number of open database transactions for a specified or default connection.

returns.description: The number of open transactions for the specified connection, or for the default connection when `sConnection` is omitted or empty.

parameters.name: sConnection
parameters.description: The name of the database connection to inspect. If omitted or empty, the default connection is used.

GetUserData.title: GetUserData
GetUserData.summary: Returns the current session user name as a string.

returns.description: The current session user name.

GetWebFolder.title: GetWebFolder
GetWebFolder.summary: Returns the current web folder path as a string.

returns.description: The current web folder path.

HasProperty.title: HasProperty
HasProperty.summary: Checks whether a value exposes a named property.

returns.description: `.T.` if the property exists on the supplied value, `.F.` otherwise

parameters.name: oTarget
parameters.description: The value to inspect for a property

parameters.name: sPropName
parameters.description: The property name to look up

HashData.title: HashData
HashData.summary: Computes a one-way hash string from input text.

returns.description: An uppercase hexadecimal hash string for `sInputData`.

parameters.name: sInputData
parameters.description: String value to hash. Passing NIL raises an error. An empty string is allowed and hashes successfully.

parameters.name: sAlgorithm
parameters.description: Hash algorithm name. Supported values are SH1 and MD5. If omitted or NIL, SH1 is used.

Hour.title: Hour
Hour.summary: Extracts the hour component from a date value.

returns.description: The hour component of `dDate`, from `0` to `23`. Returns `0` when `dDate` is empty.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: Date value to inspect

HtmlDecode.title: HtmlDecode
HtmlDecode.summary: Converts selected HTML/XML entity sequences in a string back to literal characters.

returns.description: The decoded string with supported entity sequences replaced by their literal characters. Returns `NIL` when `sData` is `NIL`.

parameters.name: sData
parameters.description: String to decode. NIL is accepted and returns NIL.

HtmlEncode.title: HtmlEncode
HtmlEncode.summary: Converts selected characters in a string to entity sequences for HTML or XML text output.

returns.description: The encoded string with `&`, `<`, `>`, `'`, and `"` replaced by their entity sequences. Returns `NIL` when `sData` is `NIL`.

parameters.name: sData
parameters.description: String to encode. NIL is accepted and returns NIL.

IIf.title: IIf
IIf.summary: Selects one of two values based on a boolean condition.

returns.description: `vTrueValue` when `bCondition` is `.T.`; otherwise `vFalseValue`.

parameters.name: bCondition
parameters.description: Condition indicating which value to return

parameters.name: vTrueValue
parameters.description: Value to return if bCondition is true

parameters.name: vFalseValue
parameters.description: Value to return if bCondition is false

IgnoreSqlErrors.title: IgnoreSqlErrors
IgnoreSqlErrors.summary: Enables or disables SQL error suppression and returns the previous setting.

returns.description: The previous SQL error suppression setting.

parameters.name: bEnable
parameters.description: .T. enables SQL error suppression. .F. restores normal SQL error throwing.

InBatchProcess.title: InBatchProcess
InBatchProcess.summary: Returns whether the current SSL execution context is running in a batch process.

returns.description: `.T.` when the current execution context is running in batch process mode; otherwise `.F.`.

InfoMes.title: InfoMes
InfoMes.summary: Logs an informational user message and returns the same formatted string as UsrMes.

returns.description: The formatted message string. If ordinary user-message logging is disabled, `InfoMes` returns an empty string.

parameters.name: vCaption
parameters.description: Caption text, or the message content when vMessage is omitted or empty.

parameters.name: vMessage
parameters.description: Message body or additional detail text.

Integer.title: Integer
Integer.summary: Returns the whole-number portion of a numeric value by truncating the fractional part toward zero.

returns.description: The input value with any fractional part removed.

parameters.name: nValue
parameters.description: Numeric value to truncate

IsDBConnected.title: IsDBConnected
IsDBConnected.summary: Checks whether STARLIMS currently has a database connection available for a given connection name.

returns.description: `.T.` if the named connection exists, or if the default connection exists when no name is supplied; otherwise `.F.`

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Connection name of the database connection to check. If omitted or passed as an empty string, the function checks the current default connection.

IsDefined.title: IsDefined
IsDefined.summary: Determines whether a variable name is currently defined.

returns.description: `.T.` when the name resolves in the current local scope, a caller scope, or public scope; `.F.` when no variable with that name exists.

parameters.name: sVarName
parameters.description: Name of the variable to check for existence. Must be non-empty.

IsGuid.title: IsGuid
IsGuid.summary: Validates whether a string matches the GUID format and returns a boolean result.

returns.description: `.T.` when `sGuid` matches the GUID format; otherwise `.F.`

parameters.name: sGuid
parameters.description: String to validate against the GUID format

IsHex.title: IsHex
IsHex.summary: Validates whether a string contains only uppercase hexadecimal characters.

returns.description: `.T.` when `sSource` contains only uppercase hexadecimal characters; otherwise `.F.`

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: String to validate against the uppercase hexadecimal character set 0-9 and A-F.

IsInTransaction.title: IsInTransaction
IsInTransaction.summary: Returns .T. if the specified database connection currently has an open transaction.

returns.description: `.T.` if the specified connection is currently within a transaction; `.F.` if not.

parameters.name: vConnection
parameters.description: Connection name or connection object specifying which database connection to check. If NIL or empty, the default connection is used.

IsInvariantDate.title: IsInvariantDate
IsInvariantDate.summary: Checks whether a date value has an unspecified (invariant) kind.

returns.description: `.T.` when `dDate` has an unspecified `DateTimeKind`; `.F.` otherwise.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: The date value to check for an unspecified DateTimeKind.

IsNumeric.title: IsNumeric
IsNumeric.summary: Determines whether a string is a valid numeric value, with optional support for hexadecimal input.

returns.description: `.T.` when `sNumber` is a valid decimal value under the current numeric settings, or a valid `0x...` or `0X...` hexadecimal string when `bAllowHex` is enabled; otherwise `.F.`.

parameters.name: sNumber
parameters.description: String to validate.

parameters.name: bAllowHex
parameters.description: When .T., also accepts whole hexadecimal strings such as 0xFF. Non-boolean values are treated as .F..

IsProductionModeOn.title: IsProductionModeOn
IsProductionModeOn.summary: Returns .T. when the application's production mode flag is enabled and .F. otherwise.

returns.description: `.T.` if the application is running in production mode; `.F.` otherwise.

IsTable.title: IsTable
IsTable.summary: Checks whether a table exists in a database connection.

returns.description: `.T.` if the table exists in the selected connection; otherwise `.F.`.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Database connection name to check against. NIL falls back to the default connection; empty string is not treated as omitted.

parameters.name: sTableName
parameters.description: Name of the table to test for existence.

IsTableFld.title: IsTableFld
IsTableFld.summary: Checks whether a field exists in a table for a selected database connection.

returns.description: `.T.` if the field exists in the selected table; otherwise `.F.`.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Database connection name to check against. NIL falls back to the default connection; empty string is not treated as omitted.

parameters.name: sTableName
parameters.description: Name of the table to inspect.

parameters.name: sFieldName
parameters.description: Name of the field to test for existence.

JDay.title: JDay
JDay.summary: Returns the day-of-year number for a date, or for today's date when no argument is supplied.

returns.description: day-of-year value for the supplied date, or for the current date when no argument is supplied

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: Date value to evaluate. If omitted or NIL, JDay() uses the current date. If an empty date value is supplied, the function returns 34.

LCase.title: LCase
LCase.summary: Conditionally evaluates one of two SSL expressions supplied as strings.

returns.description: The value produced by the selected expression.

parameters.name: bCondition
parameters.description: Determines which expression string LCase executes

parameters.name: sTrueValue
parameters.description: SSL expression text to execute when bCondition is true

parameters.name: sFalseValue
parameters.description: SSL expression text to execute when bCondition is false. If omitted, NIL, empty, or whitespace-only, LCase returns an empty string

LDAPAuth.title: LDAPAuth
LDAPAuth.summary: Authenticates a user by binding directly to an LDAP server.

returns.description: Returns `""` when the bind succeeds.

parameters.name: sLdapHost
parameters.description: LDAP server host name or address

parameters.name: nLdapPort
parameters.description: LDAP server port

parameters.name: sLdapUserName
parameters.description: User name passed to the bind operation

parameters.name: sLdapPassword
parameters.description: Password passed to the bind operation. An empty password raises an exception.

parameters.name: sLdapDistinctiveName
parameters.description: Special authentication mode selector. Use "ntlm" to perform an NTLM bind.

parameters.name: bSecure
parameters.description: When .T., enables SSL/TLS on the LDAP connection

LDAPAuthEX.title: LDAPAuthEX
LDAPAuthEX.summary: Authenticates an LDAP user by searching for exactly one directory entry and then binding as that user.

returns.description: Returns an empty string when `sAuthAttribName` is omitted or empty and authentication succeeds. Returns the requested attribute value when one attribute name is supplied. Returns a comma-delimited string when multiple attribute names are supplied. The function raises on authentication, bind, connection, or search failure; it does not return an error string for failed authentication.

parameters.name: sLdapHost
parameters.description: LDAP server host name.

parameters.name: nLdapPort
parameters.description: LDAP server port.

parameters.name: sBindUserName
parameters.description: Service-account username used for the initial bind and search.

parameters.name: sBindUserPassword
parameters.description: Password for sBindUserName. Empty or omitted values cause the bind step to fail.

parameters.name: sSearchUserName
parameters.description: User identifier inserted into sSearchFilter with string.Format(sSearchFilter, sSearchUserName). In normal usage this is the user being authenticated.

parameters.name: sSearchUserPassword
parameters.description: Password used in the second bind against the matched entry. Empty or omitted values cause authentication to fail.

parameters.name: sLdapDistinguishedName
parameters.description: Accepted in the signature but has no effect on the search or bind behavior.

parameters.name: sLdapDistinguishedNameStartSearch
parameters.description: Distinguished name that defines where the LDAP search begins.

parameters.name: sSearchFilter
parameters.description: LDAP filter pattern. When supplied, it is formatted with sSearchUserName. The search must return exactly one entry.

parameters.name: sAuthAttribName
parameters.description: Attribute name to return after successful authentication. Supply multiple names separated by commas to return multiple values in order.

parameters.name: bSecure
parameters.description: When .T., enables SSL for the LDAP connection.

LDir.title: LDir
LDir.summary: Retrieves an array of file and directory names matching a specified pattern and optional attribute filter.

returns.description: Array of entry names that match the requested path/pattern. The values are names only, not full paths or metadata.

parameters.name: sFilePattern
parameters.description: Existing directory path or directory-plus-pattern string to enumerate. Pass an explicit path such as C:\Reports\*.txt or C:\Reports. NIL or an omitted first argument raises an error instead of falling back automatically. An empty string can fall back to the current working directory, but relying on that is fragile and may still fail permission checks.

parameters.name: sAttributes
parameters.description: Inclusion flags for entry types that are excluded by default. D includes directories, H includes hidden entries, and S includes system entries. Other characters are ignored. Omitting sAttributes returns visible non-system files only.

LFromHex.title: LFromHex
LFromHex.summary: Converts a hexadecimal string to a string by reading the input in two-character chunks and decoding each chunk as a byte.

returns.description: The decoded string.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: Hexadecimal text to decode

LHex2Dec.title: LHex2Dec
LHex2Dec.summary: Converts a hexadecimal string to its decimal string representation.

returns.description: The decimal string produced from `sSource`.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: Hexadecimal text to convert

LIMSDate.title: LIMSDate
LIMSDate.summary: Returns a date value as a formatted string.

returns.description: The formatted date string, or a null-date placeholder such as `0--`, `0--0`, or a blank pattern-shaped string.

parameters.name: vDate
parameters.description: Date value to format. String inputs are parsed using the current application date format.

parameters.name: sFormat
parameters.description: Output format. If omitted or empty, LIMSDate uses dd-MMM-yy. If the supplied format contains MMM, the function uses dd-MMM-yyyy.

LKill.title: LKill
LKill.summary: Deletes a public variable from the current SSL session by name and returns an empty string.

returns.description: Always returns `""`.

parameters.name: sVarName
parameters.description: Name of the public variable to remove.

LLower.title: LLower
LLower.summary: Converts all characters in a string to their lowercase equivalents.

returns.description: The lowercase form of `sSource`.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: The string to convert to lowercase.

LSearch.title: LSearch
LSearch.summary: Returns a single value from a SQL query, or a caller-supplied fallback when the query produces no scalar result.

returns.description: The scalar result from the query, or `vDefaultValue` when no scalar value is returned.

parameters.name: sCommandString
parameters.description: SQL statement to execute. Use positional ? placeholders for parameter values.

parameters.name: vDefaultValue
parameters.description: Value returned when the query returns no row or the scalar result is database NULL.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Database connection name. If omitted, SSL uses the default connection.

parameters.name: aArrayOfValues
parameters.description: Values bound to the positional ? placeholders in sCommandString.

LSelect.title: LSelect
LSelect.summary: Executes a SQL SELECT statement and returns the result as a two-dimensional SSL array.

returns.description: A two-dimensional array of query results.

parameters.name: sCommandString
parameters.description: SQL statement to execute. Use positional ? placeholders for parameter binding.

parameters.name: aFieldList
parameters.description: Not implemented. This argument must be omitted or skipped. Passing any array value raises aFieldList != NULL - Not implemented yet.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Database connection name. If omitted, SSL uses the default connection.

parameters.name: aArrayOfValues
parameters.description: Values bound to the positional ? placeholders in sCommandString.

parameters.name: bNullAsBlank

parameters.name: aInvariantDateCols
parameters.description: Date columns to keep invariant. Pass either column names or 1-based column indexes.

LSelect1.title: LSelect1
LSelect1.summary: Executes a parameterized SQL SELECT command and returns the result as an array of rows.

returns.description: An array of rows. Each row is an array of column values in select-list order. Returns an empty array when the query matches no rows.

parameters.name: sCommandString
parameters.description: SQL SELECT statement to execute. Use positional ? placeholders for parameters.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Database connection name. If omitted, SSL uses the default connection.

parameters.name: aArrayOfValues
parameters.description: Values bound to the ? placeholders in sCommandString, in order.

parameters.name: bNullAsBlank
parameters.description: When .T., database NULL values are converted to blank SSL defaults for the column type.

parameters.name: aInvariantDateCols
parameters.description: Date columns to preserve without timezone conversion. Entries can be 1-based column indexes or column names.

LSelectC.title: LSelectC
LSelectC.summary: Executes a SQL SELECT statement and returns the result as a two-dimensional SSL array.

returns.description: A two-dimensional array of query results.

parameters.name: sCommandString
parameters.description: SQL SELECT statement to execute. Use positional ? placeholders for parameter binding.

parameters.name: aFieldList
parameters.description: Not implemented. This argument must be omitted or skipped. Passing any array value raises aFieldList != NULL - Not implemented yet.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Database connection name. If omitted, SSL uses the default connection.

parameters.name: aArrayOfValues
parameters.description: Values bound to the positional ? placeholders in sCommandString, in order.

parameters.name: bNullAsBlank
parameters.description: Controls how database NULL values are surfaced. When .T., NULL values become empty SSL defaults for the column type. When .F., NULL values are returned as NIL.

parameters.name: aInvariantDateCols
parameters.description: Date columns to keep invariant. Pass either column names or 1-based column indexes.

LStr.title: LStr
LStr.summary: Converts a value to its trimmed string representation, returning \"NIL\" when the input is NIL.

returns.description: The trimmed string form of `vNumber`, with locale-specific group and decimal separators applied when `vNumber` is a number. Returns the literal string `"NIL"` when `vNumber` is `NIL`.

parameters.name: vNumber
parameters.description: The value to convert to a string

LToHex.title: LToHex
LToHex.summary: Converts a string or integer to hexadecimal text.

returns.description: Hexadecimal encoding of `vSource`. For string input, returns the character bytes encoded as uppercase hex pairs. For numeric input, returns an 8-character zero-padded uppercase hex string. Returns the original `vSource` value unchanged (preserving its input type) when `vSource` is empty.

parameters.name: vSource
parameters.description: Value to convert. Non-empty values must be a string or a whole-number numeric value in the supported range. Empty values are returned unchanged.

LTransform.title: LTransform
LTransform.summary: Formats a numeric expression as a string by applying a picture string.

returns.description: A formatted string for numeric input, the plain string value for non-numeric input, or an empty string when `vExpression` is `NIL`.

parameters.name: vExpression
parameters.description: Value to convert. Numeric values use the picture; non-numeric values are returned as plain text.

parameters.name: sPicture
parameters.description: Numeric picture string used when vExpression is numeric. In LTransform, # and 9 are treated the same as 0.

LTrim.title: LTrim
LTrim.summary: Removes leading whitespace from a string.

returns.description: `sSource` with all leading whitespace removed. Returns an empty string when `sSource` is `""` or contains only whitespace. Trailing whitespace is preserved.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: String to trim from the left side.

LWait.title: LWait
LWait.summary: Blocks further script execution for a specified number of seconds and returns an empty string.

returns.description: Always returns `""` after the delay completes.

parameters.name: nSeconds
parameters.description: Number of seconds to wait. Fractional values are truncated. NIL or an omitted argument defaults to 0.

Left.title: Left
Left.summary: Extracts the leftmost characters from a string.

returns.description: The leftmost `nLength` characters of `sSource`. Returns the full string when `nLength` exceeds the length of `sSource`. Returns `NIL` when the effective `nLength` is zero or negative.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: Source string to read from.

parameters.name: nLength
parameters.description: Number of leading characters to return. The value is rounded to a whole number before use.

Len.title: Len
Len.summary: Returns the number of characters in a string or the element count of an array.

returns.description: The character count when `vSource` is a string, or the element count when `vSource` is an array.

parameters.name: vSource
parameters.description: The string or array to measure. Must be a string or array — other types raise an error.

LimsAt.title: LimsAt
LimsAt.summary: Finds the first occurrence of a substring in a string at or after a 1-based starting position.

returns.description: The 1-based position of the first match at or after `nOffset`, or `0` when no match is found.

parameters.name: sSubString
parameters.description: Substring to search for.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: String to search.

parameters.name: nOffset
parameters.description: 1-based starting position for the search.

LimsExec.title: LimsExec
LimsExec.summary: Launches an external application without waiting for it to finish.

returns.description: Returns `.T.` when the process starts successfully, or `.F.` when process creation fails after parameter validation.

parameters.name: sApplication
parameters.description: Executable path, or a full command line when sArguments is omitted.

parameters.name: bShow
parameters.description: Whether to show the launched window.

parameters.name: sArguments
parameters.description: Command-line arguments passed to the application. When omitted or empty, trailing text in sApplication is parsed as the argument string.

LimsGetDateFormat.title: LimsGetDateFormat
LimsGetDateFormat.summary: Returns the current global date format string used for date parsing and formatting.

returns.description: The current date format pattern used throughout the application (e.g., `"MM/dd/yyyy"`).

LimsNETCast.title: LimsNETCast
LimsNETCast.summary: Prepares a value for a requested interop type such as an enum, by-reference value, numeric type, or typed array.

returns.description: A value prepared according to `sNewType`, or the original value when no cast path applies.

parameters.name: vVal
parameters.description: Value to prepare for the requested target type. NIL is allowed and is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: sNewType
parameters.description: Target type instruction such as enum:Namespace.Type, byref, a numeric type name, or an array type name.

LimsNETConnect.title: LimsNETConnect
LimsNETConnect.summary: Loads a .NET assembly, resolves a type, and either returns a type handle or creates an instance for SSL interop.

returns.description: Return shape depends on how you call the function.

parameters.name: sAssembly
parameters.description: Assembly name or .dll path to load. If the value ends with .dll, the runtime first checks that path, then also checks the application's Components folder. When NIL, the runtime uses the default .NET assembly containing System.String.

parameters.name: sTypeName
parameters.description: Fully qualified .NET type name to resolve from the loaded assembly. If omitted or empty, the function returns the assembly object.

parameters.name: aArgs
parameters.description: Constructor arguments for instance creation.

parameters.name: bAsStatic
parameters.description: Pass .T. to return the resolved type for static access instead of creating an instance. Values other than .T. behave like .F..

LimsNETTypeOf.title: LimsNETTypeOf
LimsNETTypeOf.summary: Resolves a .NET type name string to a .NET Type object.

returns.description: A .NET `Type` object for the resolved type name.

parameters.name: sTypeName
parameters.description: Type name to resolve. Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored. Built-in aliases such as string, int, bool, datetime, and object are supported, as are fully qualified type names.

LimsOleConnect.title: LimsOleConnect
LimsOleConnect.summary: Creates an object from a ProgID so SSL code can work with an OLE or COM automation server.

returns.description: The created object for the requested ProgID.

parameters.name: vProgId
parameters.description: Value whose text form is used as the ProgID to create

LimsRecordsAffected.title: LimsRecordsAffected
LimsRecordsAffected.summary: Returns the number of records affected by the most recent database operation.

returns.description: Number of records affected by the last database operation.

LimsSetCounter.title: LimsSetCounter
LimsSetCounter.summary: Generates the next counter value and, when given matching field and value arrays, inserts a new row with that key.

returns.description: The generated numeric counter value.

parameters.name: sTableName
parameters.description: Target table name. The generated key is inserted into this table when the field and value arrays match.

parameters.name: sFieldName
parameters.description: Column that receives the generated key value.

parameters.name: sPrefix
parameters.description: Optional counter qualifier. When supplied, the inserted key becomes sPrefix + nextNumber.

parameters.name: aFields
parameters.description: Additional column names to include in the insert. Do not repeat sFieldName here.

parameters.name: aValues
parameters.description: Values for aFields, in the same order.

parameters.name: nIncrementWith
parameters.description: Optional whole-number increment. Non-integer values do not change the default behavior.

LimsSqlConnect.title: LimsSqlConnect
LimsSqlConnect.summary: Registers a configured database connection by connection name.

returns.description: `.T.` if the connection name was registered successfully; otherwise `.F.`.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Connection name of the configured connection to register. If the runtime supplies a null value, SSL substitutes the current default connection name before lookup.

LimsSqlDisconnect.title: LimsSqlDisconnect
LimsSqlDisconnect.summary: Closes an active database connection by name and removes it from the internal registry.

returns.description: `.T.` if the disconnect operation succeeded; `.F.` otherwise.

parameters.name: sConnectionName
parameters.description: Connection name of the connection to disconnect. When NIL, falls back to the system default connection.

LimsString.title: LimsString
LimsString.summary: Converts a value to a string, returning \"NIL\" when the input is NIL.

returns.description: `"NIL"` for null input, a separator-formatted string for numeric input, or the value's normal string form for other non-null input.

parameters.name: vSource
parameters.description: Value to convert. If omitted or NIL, the function returns "NIL".

LimsTime.title: LimsTime
LimsTime.summary: Returns the current time as a formatted string.

returns.description: The current time formatted with the active time format.

LimsType.title: LimsType
LimsType.summary: Returns the single-character SSL type code for a variable name or expression.

returns.description: A single-character type code based on what `sParam` evaluates to.

parameters.name: sParam
parameters.description: Variable name or SSL expression to inspect.

LimsTypeEx.title: LimsTypeEx
LimsTypeEx.summary: Returns the public SSL type name for a value.

returns.description: An uppercase SSL type name.

parameters.name: vSource
parameters.description: Value to inspect.

LimsXOr.title: LimsXOr
LimsXOr.summary: Calculates the bitwise exclusive OR of two integer-valued numbers.

returns.description: The bitwise XOR of `nVal1` and `nVal2`.

parameters.name: nVal1
parameters.description: First operand. Must be an integer-valued number.

parameters.name: nVal2
parameters.description: Second operand. Must be an integer-valued number.

Lower.title: Lower
Lower.summary: Converts all characters in a string to lowercase.

returns.description: The lowercase form of `sSource`.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: The string to convert to lowercase.

MakeDateInvariant.title: MakeDateInvariant
MakeDateInvariant.summary: Marks a date, or selected date columns in an array, as invariant.

returns.description: The same value passed in, after its date kind is changed to invariant.

parameters.name: vDate
parameters.description: A single date value, a one-dimensional array of dates, or an array of rows containing date values.

parameters.name: vColumnsIndex
parameters.description: Required when vDate is an array. Use a single column index or an array of column indices to choose which positions to mark as invariant.

MakeDateLocal.title: MakeDateLocal
MakeDateLocal.summary: Sets a date value, or selected date columns in an array, to local date kind in place.

returns.description: The same value passed in, updated in place.

parameters.name: vDate
parameters.description: The date to update, or an array whose targeted columns contain dates.

parameters.name: vColumnsIndex
parameters.description: The column number, or array of column numbers, to update when vDate is an array. Required when vDate is an array; ignored for a single date.

MakeDirOnFtp.title: MakeDirOnFtp
MakeDirOnFtp.summary: Creates a remote directory by using FTP, or by using SFTP when bIsSFTP is .T..

returns.description: `.T.` when the remote directory creation call succeeds; `.F.` when the FTP request fails (handled as a `WebException` on the FTP path) or when the directory-creation call fails after a successful connect and login (SFTP path).

parameters.name: sServerNameOrIP
parameters.description: Remote server host name or IP address.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectory
parameters.description: Remote directory path to create.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name passed to the FTP or SFTP login operation.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: FTP password, or SFTP password or private-key passphrase.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: Server port. If omitted or less than or equal to 0, the implementation uses 21 on both the FTP and SFTP paths.

parameters.name: sProxy
parameters.description: Must be omitted, NIL, or an empty string. A non-empty value raises an error.

parameters.name: bIsSFTP
parameters.description: Set to .T. to use the SFTP implementation. Omit it or pass NIL/.F. to use FTP.

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: Optional private key file for SFTP authentication. Ignored on the FTP path.

MakeNETObject.title: MakeNETObject
MakeNETObject.summary: Converts an SSL value to a .NET interop object.

returns.description: A .NET interop object wrapping the supplied value. Returns `NIL` when `vValue` is `NIL`, or the original object unchanged when `vValue` is already a .NET interop object.

parameters.name: vValue
parameters.description: SSL value to convert for .NET interop.

MatFunc.title: MatFunc
MatFunc.summary: Calculates a mathematical operation on a given number based on the specified function name.

returns.description: Result of the selected mathematical operation.

parameters.name: sFunctionName
parameters.description: Mathematical operation name. Supported values are ABS, ACOT, ATAN, COS, COT, EXP, FACT, FRAC, LOG, LOG10, PI, RAND, SIN, SQRT, and TAN.

parameters.name: nNumber
parameters.description: Numeric input value. PI and RAND still require this argument even though the underlying calculation does not use it.

Max.title: Max
Max.summary: Returns whichever of two values compares greater when both arguments are the same supported type.

returns.description: The greater of the two input values, in the same type as the inputs.

parameters.name: vValue1
parameters.description: First value to compare. Must be the same supported type as vValue2.

parameters.name: vValue2
parameters.description: Second value to compare. Must be the same supported type as vValue1.

MimeDecode.title: MimeDecode
MimeDecode.summary: Decodes MIME-encoded data to its plain string representation.

returns.description: The decoded string when `sValue` begins with the SSL MIME signature. Returns `sValue` unchanged when it does not start with the signature. Returns `""` when `sValue` is an empty string.

parameters.name: sValue
parameters.description: The MIME-encoded string to decode. Must be a non-null string; passing any other type raises an exception.

MimeEncode.title: MimeEncode
MimeEncode.summary: Encodes a string so it can be round-tripped later with MimeDecode.

returns.description: Encoded string value.

parameters.name: sValue
parameters.description: String to encode.

Min.title: Min
Min.summary: Returns whichever of two values compares lower when both arguments are the same supported type.

returns.description: The lesser of the two input values, in the same type as the inputs.

parameters.name: vValue1
parameters.description: First value to compare. Must be the same supported type as vValue2.

parameters.name: vValue2
parameters.description: Second value to compare. Must be the same supported type as vValue1.

Minute.title: Minute
Minute.summary: Extracts the minute component from a date value.

returns.description: The minute component of `dDate`, from `0` to `59`. Returns `0` when `dDate` is empty.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: Date value to inspect

Month.title: Month
Month.summary: Extracts the numeric month from a date value.

returns.description: Returns `1` to `12` for a valid date, or `0` when `dDate` is an empty date.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: The date value from which to extract the month number.

MoveInFtp.title: MoveInFtp
MoveInFtp.summary: Moves a remote file on an FTP server, or on an SFTP server when bIsSFTP is .T..

returns.description: `.T.` when the source file is retrieved, the target file is written, and the source file is removed; `.F.` when any of those steps fails.

parameters.name: sServerNameOrIP
parameters.description: Remote server name or IP address.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectoryFrom
parameters.description: Source directory portion of the remote path. Empty values are passed through to the underlying FTP or SFTP download step.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectoryTo
parameters.description: Target directory portion of the remote path. Empty values are passed through as-is; this parameter does not automatically reuse sRemoteDirectoryFrom.

parameters.name: sRemoteFileFrom
parameters.description: Source remote file name.

parameters.name: sRemoteFileTo
parameters.description: Target remote file name. When omitted or empty, the source file name is reused.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name passed to the FTP or SFTP login operation.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password for password-based login. On the SFTP path, this is also used as the private-key passphrase when sPrivateKeyFilePath is supplied.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: Server port. If omitted or non-positive, the implementation uses 21, even on the SFTP path.

parameters.name: sProxy
parameters.description: Must be left empty. Supplying a non-empty value raises an error.

parameters.name: bIsSFTP
parameters.description: Set to .T. to use the SFTP implementation. Omitted or NIL keeps the FTP implementation.

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: Optional private key file for SFTP authentication. Ignored on the FTP path.

NoOfDays.title: NoOfDays
NoOfDays.summary: Returns the number of days in the month for a date value.

returns.description: The number of days in `dDate`'s month, or `0` when `dDate` is empty

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: Date value whose month length should be returned

Nothing.title: Nothing
Nothing.summary: Returns .T. when vValue is NIL, empty by SSL rules, or stringifies to the exact value \"0\"; otherwise returns .F..

parameters.name: vValue
parameters.description: Value to test for NIL, SSL-empty state, or the exact stringified value "0".

Now.title: Now
Now.summary: Returns the current system date and time as an SSL date value.

PrepareArrayForIn.title: PrepareArrayForIn
PrepareArrayForIn.summary: Prepares an array for SQL IN clause helpers by mutating it in place.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Array to modify in place before building an SQL IN clause.

parameters.name: sItemType
parameters.description: Type name used only when aTarget is empty. Recognized values are string, numeric, and date, case-insensitively.

PrmCount.title: PrmCount
PrmCount.summary: Returns how many arguments were passed to the currently executing procedure.

returns.description: The number of arguments passed to the current procedure call.

RaiseError.title: RaiseError
RaiseError.summary: Raises an SSL runtime error using the supplied message and optional location, error code, and inner error.

returns.description: The surfaced return type is boolean, but `RaiseError` does not return normally because it always raises an error.

parameters.name: sMessage
parameters.description: Message text for the error being raised.

parameters.name: sLocation
parameters.description: Operation or location text to attach to the raised error.

parameters.name: nErrorCode
parameters.description: Numeric code to attach to the raised error.

parameters.name: oInnerException
parameters.description: Existing SSL error to preserve as the inner error.

Rand.title: Rand
Rand.summary: Generates a pseudo-random number between 0 (inclusive) and 1 (exclusive).

returns.description: A pseudo-random number greater than or equal to `0` and less than `1`.

parameters.name: nSeed
parameters.description: Optional numeric seed. When supplied, the value is converted to an integer and used to reseed the shared generator before the function returns a value.

Rat.title: Rat
Rat.summary: Finds the last occurrence of a substring in a string and returns its one-based position.

returns.description: The one-based position of the last match, or `0` when no match is found.

parameters.name: subStr
parameters.description: Substring to look for.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: String to search.

ReadBytesBase64.title: ReadBytesBase64
ReadBytesBase64.summary: Reads a file from disk and returns its contents as a base64-encoded string.

returns.description: The file contents encoded as base64.

parameters.name: sFileName
parameters.description: Path to the file to read and encode.

ReadFromFtp.title: ReadFromFtp
ReadFromFtp.summary: Retrieves a remote file as a string by using FTP, or SFTP when bIsSFTP is .T..

returns.description: The remote file contents; an empty string when the FTP or SFTP read operation fails with a handled transfer error.

parameters.name: sServerNameOrIP
parameters.description: FTP or SFTP server name or IP address. Empty values raise an exception.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectory
parameters.description: Remote folder that contains the file.

parameters.name: sRemoteFileName
parameters.description: File name to read. Empty values raise an exception.

parameters.name: nMaxSize
parameters.description: Maximum bytes to read on the FTP path. On the current SFTP path, the full file is still read.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name passed to the FTP or SFTP login routine.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password passed to the login routine. When sPrivateKeyFilePath is used for SFTP, this value is used as the private-key passphrase.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: Network port for the connection.

parameters.name: sProxy
parameters.description: Must be omitted or empty. Any non-empty value raises an exception.

parameters.name: bIsSFTP
parameters.description: Pass .T. to use SFTP instead of FTP.

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: Private key file for SFTP authentication. Ignored on the FTP path.

ReadText.title: ReadText
ReadText.summary: Retrieves text content from a file in memory, allowing partial reads and encoding selection.

returns.description: The file contents, or the first `nCharsToRead` characters when a positive limit is provided.

parameters.name: sFileName
parameters.description: The path to the text file to read.

parameters.name: nCharsToRead
parameters.description: The maximum number of characters to return. If omitted, NIL, or less than or equal to zero, the function returns the full text.

parameters.name: sEncoding
parameters.description: The text encoding to use. If omitted or NIL, the function uses UTF8.

RenameOnFtp.title: RenameOnFtp
RenameOnFtp.summary: Renames a remote file on an FTP server, or on an SFTP server when bIsSFTP is .T..

returns.description: `.T.` when the rename completes; `.F.` when the underlying FTP or SFTP move helper cannot complete the rename.

parameters.name: sServerNameOrIP
parameters.description: Remote server name or IP address.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectory
parameters.description: Remote directory that contains the file. The same directory is used for both the source and target path.

parameters.name: sFileNameOld
parameters.description: Existing remote file name to rename.

parameters.name: sFileNameNew
parameters.description: New remote file name to apply in the same directory.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name passed to the FTP or SFTP login step.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password for password-based login. On the SFTP path, this value is also used as the private-key passphrase when sPrivateKeyFilePath is supplied.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: Server port. If omitted or non-positive, the implementation uses 21, even on the SFTP path.

parameters.name: sProxy
parameters.description: Must be left empty. Supplying a non-empty value raises an error.

parameters.name: bIsSFTP
parameters.description: Set to .T. to use the SFTP implementation. Omitted or NIL keeps the FTP implementation.

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: Optional private key file for SFTP authentication. Ignored on the FTP path.

Replace.title: Replace
Replace.summary: Replaces all occurrences of a specified substring within a string with another substring and returns the resulting string.

parameters.name: searchFor
parameters.description: Substring to search for.

parameters.description: Substring to replace occurrences with.

Replicate.summary: Creates a string by repeating the source string a specified number of times.

parameters.description: Source string to be repeated

parameters.description: Number of times to repeat the source string

RetrieveLong.title: RetrieveLong

ReturnLastSQLError.title: ReturnLastSQLError
ReturnLastSQLError.summary: Returns the currently stored SQL error as an SSLSQLError object, or NIL when no SQL error is recorded.

Right.title: Right
Right.summary: Extracts a specified number of characters from the end of a string.

parameters.description: Source string to read from.

Round.title: Round
Round.summary: Rounds a numeric value to a specific number of decimal places using a configurable midpoint handling strategy.

returns.description: The rounded number.

parameters.name: nValue
parameters.description: The number to be rounded.

parameters.name: nDigits
parameters.description: Number of decimal places to round to.

parameters.name: sMidPointRounding
parameters.description: Rounding midpoint mode. Pass "AwayFromZero" (case-insensitive) to round halfway values away from zero; any other value or omitting the argument entirely selects banker's rounding.

RoundPoint5.title: RoundPoint5
RoundPoint5.summary: Rounds a numeric value to a half-point increment.

returns.description: The input rounded to the nearest half-point value.

parameters.description: Numeric value to round to the nearest 0.5.

RunApp.title: RunApp

parameters.description: Command-line arguments passed to the application. When omitted or empty, trailing text in sApplication is parsed as the argument string.

RunDS.title: RunDS

RunSQL.title: RunSQL
RunSQL.summary: Executes a SQL statement and returns whether execution completed without an uncaught SQL error.

parameters.name: sConnectionName

SQLExecute.title: SQLExecute

SQLRemoveComments.title: SQLRemoveComments
SQLRemoveComments.summary: Removes SQL comments from a string and returns the cleaned SQL text.

parameters.description: SQL text to clean. NIL is accepted and returned unchanged.

Scient.title: Scient

parameters.description: Enables SSL/TLS on the LDAP connection when .T..

Seconds.title: Seconds
Seconds.summary: Returns the current time of day as the number of whole seconds since midnight.

SendLimsEmail.title: SendLimsEmail
SendLimsEmail.summary: Sends an email through SMTP and returns whether the send succeeded.

parameters.name: sFromWho

parameters.name: sSubject
parameters.description: Subject line. The surfaced signature allows it to be omitted, but the normal send path rejects an empty subject.

parameters.name: sMessageBody
parameters.description: Message body text.

parameters.name: aAttachList

parameters.name: aCCList
parameters.description: CC recipient addresses.

parameters.name: aBCCList
parameters.description: BCC recipient addresses.

parameters.name: sReplyTo
parameters.description: Reply-to address.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: SMTP server port.

parameters.name: sUName
parameters.description: SMTP user name.

parameters.name: sUPass
parameters.description: SMTP password.

parameters.name: bIgnoreErrors
parameters.description: When .T., logs the failure and returns .F.. When .F., raises the error instead.

parameters.name: bUseCDO

parameters.name: nTimeout

parameters.name: bUseSSL

parameters.name: bIsBodyHTML

parameters.name: sEncryptedData

SendOutlookReminder.title: SendOutlookReminder
SendOutlookReminder.summary: Sends an Outlook-style meeting invitation email and returns whether delivery succeeded.

parameters.name: sSMTP
parameters.description: SMTP server name. Blank values fail the send.

parameters.name: dStart

parameters.name: dEnd

parameters.name: sSubject
parameters.description: Subject used for the email and meeting request title. Blank values fail the send.

parameters.name: sSummary

parameters.name: sLocation
parameters.description: Meeting location text. Pass "" when you do not want to show a location.

parameters.name: sOrganizerName

parameters.name: sOrganizerEmail

parameters.name: sAttendeeName
parameters.description: Attendee display name, or a comma-separated list of attendee names. Keep the number of names aligned with sAttendeeEmail.

parameters.name: sAttendeeEmail

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: SMTP port. 0 is also treated as 25.

parameters.name: sUName

parameters.name: sUPass

parameters.name: bIgnoreErrors

parameters.name: bUseSSL

SendToFtp.title: SendToFtp
SendToFtp.summary: Uploads one local file to an FTP or SFTP server.

returns.description: `.T.` when the file upload completes successfully; `.F.` when the selected backend catches a file-read or transfer error during the upload attempt.

parameters.name: sServerNameOrIP
parameters.description: FTP or SFTP server name or IP address.

parameters.name: sRemoteDirectory
parameters.description: Remote folder path passed to the selected backend.

parameters.name: sRemoteFileName
parameters.description: Remote file name. If omitted, empty, or NIL, the function uses the file name portion of sLocalFileName.

parameters.name: sLocalFileName
parameters.description: Local file path to upload.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name for the FTP or SFTP login step.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: Password for FTP login. In SFTP mode, it is used for password login when sPrivateKeyFilePath is empty, or as the private-key passphrase when sPrivateKeyFilePath is provided.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: Port number. Omitted, NIL, or non-positive values fall back to 21. Pass 22 explicitly when the SFTP server expects the standard SFTP port.

parameters.name: sProxy

parameters.name: bUsePassive

parameters.name: bIsSFTP

parameters.name: sPrivateKeyFilePath
parameters.description: SFTP-only private key path. When provided, the SFTP branch attempts private-key authentication. Ignored in FTP mode.

SendToOutbox.title: SendToOutbox
SendToOutbox.summary: Queues an email request in LIMSEMAILOUTBOX for later delivery instead of sending it immediately.

returns.description: `.T.` when the outbox row is written successfully; `.F.` when the queue operation fails without raising, such as the `bIgnoreErrors` handling for `NIL` required arguments.

parameters.name: sSMTP

parameters.name: aRecipients
