parameters.name: sFromWho
parameters.description: Sender address. NIL is handled by bIgnoreErrors; an empty string is invalid.

parameters.name: sSubject
parameters.description: Subject line.

parameters.name: sMessageBody
parameters.description: Message body text.

parameters.name: aAttachList
parameters.description: Attachment path array.

parameters.name: aCCList
parameters.description: CC recipient array.

parameters.name: aBCCList
parameters.description: BCC recipient array.

parameters.name: sReplyTo
parameters.description: Reply-to address.

parameters.name: nPort
parameters.description: SMTP port. 0 is also treated as 25.

parameters.name: sUName
parameters.description: SMTP user name.

parameters.name: sUPass
parameters.description: SMTP password.

parameters.name: bIgnoreErrors
parameters.description: Accepted for API compatibility. The three required-argument validation throws occur unconditionally regardless of this value.

parameters.name: bUseSSL
parameters.description: Uses a secure SMTP connection.

parameters.name: bIsBodyHTML
parameters.description: Marks the body as HTML.

parameters.name: sEncryptedData
parameters.description: Additional encrypted payload stored with the queued message.

ServerEndOfDay.title: ServerEndOfDay
ServerEndOfDay.summary: Returns a date value set to the end of its day.

returns.description: A date value set to `23:59:59.997` for the same calendar day as the input. If `dDate` is an empty date, the original value is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: The date value to convert to the end of its day.

ServerStartOfDay.title: ServerStartOfDay
ServerStartOfDay.summary: Returns a date value set to the start of its day.

returns.description: A date value set to `00:00:00` for the same calendar day as the input. If `dDate` is an empty date, the original value is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: dDate
parameters.description: The date value to convert to the start of its day.

ServerTimeZone.title: ServerTimeZone
ServerTimeZone.summary: Returns the current server's UTC offset in minutes as a number.

returns.description: The server's current UTC offset in minutes. Positive values mean the server is ahead of UTC, and negative values mean it is behind UTC.

SetByName.title: SetByName
SetByName.summary: Assigns a value to a variable whose name is supplied at runtime.

returns.description: The same `vValue` that was assigned.

parameters.name: sName
parameters.description: Name of the variable to update

parameters.name: vValue
parameters.description: Value to assign

SetDecimalSeparator.title: SetDecimalSeparator
SetDecimalSeparator.summary: Sets the current decimal separator and returns the previous setting.

returns.description: The previous decimal separator value.

parameters.name: sDecimalSep
parameters.description: New decimal separator. It must be exactly one character long.

SetDefaultConnection.title: SetDefaultConnection
SetDefaultConnection.summary: Changes the active default database connection name and returns the previous default connection.

returns.description: The previous default connection name.

parameters.name: sDefaultConnection
parameters.description: Connection name to store as the new default connection

SetGroupSeparator.title: SetGroupSeparator
SetGroupSeparator.summary: Changes the group (thousands) separator character used when numbers are formatted as strings across the application.

returns.description: The previous group separator value before the change was applied.

parameters.name: sGroupSep
parameters.description: The character to use as the group separator in numeric values (typically a comma or space).

SetInternal.title: SetInternal
SetInternal.summary: Assigns a value to a named property on a target value and returns NIL.

returns.description: Always returns `NIL`.

parameters.name: oTarget
parameters.description: Target value whose property will be assigned

parameters.description: Name of the property to set

SetInternalC.title: SetInternalC
SetInternalC.summary: Assigns a value through a chained index path on a target value and returns NIL.

SetSqlTimeout.title: SetSqlTimeout
SetSqlTimeout.summary: Sets the SQL command timeout for a database connection and returns the previous timeout value for that same connection.

returns.description: The previous SQL command timeout for the targeted connection.

parameters.name: nTimeout
parameters.description: New SQL command timeout in seconds. When supplied, it must be an integer-valued number.

parameters.name: sConnection
parameters.description: Connection name to update. If omitted, NIL, or "", the current default connection is used.

SetUserData.title: SetUserData
SetUserData.summary: Sets the current user name for the active execution context.

returns.description: `SetUserData` updates context state and does not return a value.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: Non-empty user name to store in the current execution context.

SetUserPassword.title: SetUserPassword
SetUserPassword.summary: Updates a user's password and returns the stored password hash.

returns.description: The stored password hash when the update succeeds; otherwise `""`.

parameters.name: sUserName
parameters.description: User name whose password should be updated. Passing NIL raises an exception. Empty string is allowed but typically results in "" being returned because no user is updated.

parameters.name: sPassword
parameters.description: New password value to hash and store. Passing NIL raises an exception. Empty string is allowed and is hashed as provided.

ShowSqlErrors.title: ShowSqlErrors
ShowSqlErrors.summary: Sets the SQL error display flag and returns the previous setting.

returns.description: The previous SQL error display setting.

parameters.name: bEnable
parameters.description: .T. enables SQL error display. .F. disables it.

SigFig.title: SigFig
SigFig.summary: Returns a string produced by applying a named rounding standard to a numeric value.

returns.description: The formatted string returned by the selected rounding routine.

parameters.name: sStandard
parameters.description: Rounding standard name. The implementation has explicit handling for FDA, EPA, and ISO.

parameters.name: nDigits
parameters.description: Digit count passed to the rounding routine.

parameters.name: nValue
parameters.description: Numeric value to round and format.

SortArray.title: SortArray
SortArray.summary: Sorts an array in place and returns the same array.

returns.description: The same array after its elements have been reordered.

parameters.name: aTarget
parameters.description: Array to sort in place.

Sqrt.title: Sqrt
Sqrt.summary: Calculates the non-negative square root of a numeric value.

returns.description: The square root of `nNumber`, or `NaN` when `nNumber` is negative.

parameters.name: nNumber
parameters.description: Numeric value whose square root will be returned.

StdRound.title: StdRound
StdRound.summary: Returns a string produced by applying a named rounding standard to a numeric value.

returns.description: The formatted string returned by the selected rounding routine.

parameters.name: sStandard
parameters.description: Rounding standard name. Supported names are FDA, EPA, and ISO.

parameters.description: Whole-number digit count passed to the selected rounding routine. FDA and ISO use it as decimal digits; EPA uses it in its own significant-digit-style rounding path.

parameters.name: nNumber
parameters.description: Numeric value to round and format.

Str.title: Str
Str.summary: Converts a numeric value to a formatted string.

parameters.description: Total field width. If omitted, the function chooses a default width based on the other arguments and the value.

StrSrch.title: StrSrch
StrSrch.summary: Finds a substring by occurrence number or from a specific 1-based starting position.

returns.description: The 1-based position of the matching substring, or `0` when no match is found.

parameters.name: subStr
parameters.description: Substring to search for.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: String to search.

parameters.name: indexOrOccurence
parameters.description: Occurrence number when flag is .F., or 1-based starting position when flag is .T..

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: Controls how indexOrOccurence is interpreted.

StrTran.title: StrTran
StrTran.summary: Replaces all occurrences of a specified substring with another substring in a source string.

returns.description: New string containing the replacement result.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Source string where the search is performed.

parameters.name: searchFor
parameters.description: Literal substring to find.

parameters.name: replaceWith
parameters.description: Replacement text. If omitted, StrTran() uses an empty string.

StrZero.title: StrZero
StrZero.summary: Formats a number as a zero-padded string, with optional total width and decimal precision.

returns.description: The formatted number, left-padded with zeros to the requested width. Returns a string of `*` characters when the value overflows the requested width.

parameters.name: nNumber
parameters.description: Number to format.

parameters.name: nLength
parameters.description: Total output width.

parameters.description: Number of decimal places.

StringToDate.title: StringToDate
StringToDate.summary: Converts a formatted date string into a date value using a specified pattern.

returns.description: Parsed date when conversion succeeds. Returns an empty date when the input does not match the supplied format.

parameters.name: sDateString
parameters.description: Date string containing the date representation to parse.

parameters.name: sDateFormat
parameters.description: Date format pattern used for parsing the date string.

SubStr.title: SubStr
SubStr.summary: Extracts part of a string starting at a position you specify.

returns.description: The extracted substring. Returns `""` when the computed start position is at or beyond the end of the string.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: Source string to read from.

parameters.name: nStartPos
parameters.description: Start position. Positive values are 1-based, 0 starts at the first character, and negative values count from the end.

parameters.name: nLength
parameters.description: Number of characters to return.

SubmitToBatch.title: SubmitToBatch
SubmitToBatch.summary: Submits SSL code to a batch worker and returns the submitted job identifier.

parameters.description: SSL source code to run in batch. If NIL or empty, nothing is submitted and the function returns "".

parameters.description: Either an array of positional parameters for the submitted code, or an object containing Parameters (array) and optional Caption (string).

parameters.description: Batch routing mode. Recognized values are "queue", "external", and "internal". Unrecognized values are treated as omitted.

SubmitToBatchEx.title: SubmitToBatchEx
SubmitToBatchEx.summary: Submits SSL code to batch execution and returns the submitted job identifier.

parameters.name: sCode
parameters.description: SSL source code to submit. If NIL or empty, nothing is submitted and the function returns "".

TableFldLst.title: TableFldLst
TableFldLst.summary: Returns the field names for a table on a selected database connection.

parameters.description: Database connection name to inspect. Empty string is not treated as omitted.

parameters.description: Name of the table whose fields should be returned.

Time.title: Time
Time.summary: Returns the current time as a formatted string.

ToJson.title: ToJson
ToJson.summary: Serializes an SSL value, array, or object to a JSON string.

ToNumeric.title: ToNumeric
ToNumeric.summary: Converts a string to a number, with optional hexadecimal support.

parameters.description: String to convert. Leading and trailing whitespace are ignored.

parameters.description: When .T., also accepts whole hexadecimal strings such as 0xFF. Non-boolean values are treated as .F..

ToScientific.title: ToScientific
ToScientific.summary: Converts a numeric value to a scientific-notation string.

parameters.name: nNumber
parameters.description: Numeric value to format

parameters.name: nDecimalPlaces
parameters.description: Integer number of digits after the decimal point

ToXml.title: ToXml
ToXml.summary: Serializes a value, array, or dynamic object to an XML string.

parameters.description: Value to serialize. NIL, primitive values, arrays, and dynamic objects are supported.

Today.title: Today
Today.summary: Returns the current date as a date object.

Trim.title: Trim
Trim.summary: Removes trailing whitespace from a string.

returns.description: `sSource` with trailing whitespace removed.

parameters.name: sSource
parameters.description: String whose trailing whitespace is removed.

UpdLong.title: UpdLong
UpdLong.summary: Updates a large field value in a database table from the contents of a file, using search criteria for row selection.

returns.description: Returns `.T.` when the update completes and affects at least one row. `UpdLong` does not return `.F.` on failure; error cases raise an exception instead.

parameters.description: SQL WHERE clause used to identify the target row.

parameters.description: Path to the input file containing the long data to update.

Upper.title: Upper
Upper.summary: Converts all characters in a string to uppercase.

UserTimeZone.title: UserTimeZone
UserTimeZone.summary: Returns the current user's UTC offset in minutes. If a user-specific offset is not available as a numeric value, the function returns the server's UTC offset instead.

UsrMes.title: UsrMes

WriteBytesBase64.summary: Writes a base64-encoded value to disk as binary file content.

Year.title: Year

_NOT.title: _NOT
_NOT.summary: Returns the bitwise complement of a whole-number operand.

returns.description: The bitwise complement of `nOperand`.

parameters.name: nOperand
parameters.description: Whole-number value to invert. Fractional numbers are rejected.

_OR.title: _OR
_OR.summary: Returns the bitwise inclusive OR of two whole-number operands.

returns.description: Numeric result whose bits are set when they are set in `nValue1`, `nValue2`, or both.

parameters.name: nValue1
parameters.description: First whole-number operand.

parameters.name: nValue2
parameters.description: Second whole-number operand.

_XOR.title: _XOR
_XOR.summary: Returns the bitwise exclusive OR of two whole-number operands.

returns.description: Numeric result whose bits are set only where `nValue1` and `nValue2` differ.

parameters.name: nValue1
parameters.description: The first operand for the bitwise XOR. Must be a whole number; fractional values raise a runtime error.

parameters.name: nValue2
parameters.description: The second operand for the bitwise XOR. Must be a whole number; fractional values raise a runtime error.
